1 CREDIT AGREEMENT This CREDIT AGREEMENT, dated as of August 14, 2026 (as amended, restated, amended and restated, supplemented or otherwise modified from time to time, this “Agreement”), is by and among (i) Carvana Co., a Delaware corporation (the “Carvana Borrower” and a “Borrower”), (ii) each lender from time to time party hereto (collectively, the “Lenders” and individually, a “Lender”) and (iii) Barclays Bank PLC, as the Administrative Agent. PRELIMINARY STATEMENTS WHEREAS, the Borrower has requested that, upon the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions precedent set forth in the applicable provisions of Section 6, the applicable Lenders extend credit in the form of a senior secured term loan facility on the Closing Date in an aggregate principal amount of $1,660,000,000. WHEREAS, the Borrower intends to use the proceeds of the Initial Term Loans funded (a) to repay or refinance the full amount of the 9.0% / 11.0% / 13.0% Cash / PIK Senior Secured Notes due 2030 under that certain Indenture, dated as of September 1, 2023, by and among the Borrower, certain guarantors party thereto and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee and collateral agent (the “Closing Date Refinancing”), (b) to pay Transaction Costs and (c) to the extent not applied for a purpose set out in clauses (a) and (b) above, for general corporate purposes or working capital requirements of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries (this paragraph, “Closing Date Use of Proceeds”). WHEREAS, the Lenders have indicated their willingness to lend on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto covenant and agree as follows: SECTION 1. DEFINITIONS 1.1 Defined Terms. As used in this Agreement, the terms listed in this Section 1.1 shall have the respective meanings set forth in this Section 1.1. “2031 Notes Indenture”: that certain Indenture, dated as of September 1, 2023, by and among the Borrower, certain guarantors party thereto and U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, as trustee and collateral agent, with respect to the 9.0% / 14.0% Cash / PIK Senior Secured Notes due 2031. “Acquired Indebtedness”: with respect to any Person (a) Indebtedness of any other Person or any of its Subsidiaries existing at the time such other Person becomes a Restricted Subsidiary or merges or amalgamates with or into or consolidates or otherwise combines with the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary and (b) Indebtedness secured by a Lien encumbering any asset acquired by such Person. Acquired Indebtedness shall be deemed to have been Incurred, with respect to clause (a) of the preceding sentence, on the date such Person becomes a Restricted Subsidiary or on the date of the relevant merger, amalgamation, consolidation, acquisition or other combination. “Additional Lender”: as defined in Section 4.17(b). “Administrative Agent”: Barclays Bank PLC, in its capacity as administrative agent and collateral agent under any of the Loan Documents, or any successor agent appointed in accordance with Section 10.9.

 
2 “Affected Financial Institution”: (a) any EEA Financial Institution or (b) any UK Financial Institution. “Affiliate”: of any specified Person means any other Person, directly or indirectly, controlling or controlled by or under direct or indirect common control with such specified Person. For the purposes of this definition, “control” when used with respect to any Person means the power to direct the management and policies of such Person, directly or indirectly, whether through the ownership of voting securities or by contract; and the terms “controlling” and “controlled” have meanings correlative to the foregoing. “Affiliate Transaction”: as defined in Section 7.16. “Affiliated Lender Assignment and Assumption”: an Affiliated Lender Assignment and Assumption, substantially in the form of Exhibit E-2 or otherwise in form and substance reasonably acceptable to the Administrative Agent and the Borrower. “Affiliated Lenders”: the Borrower, its Subsidiaries and their respective Affiliates. “Aggregate Exposure”: as to any Lender at any time, an amount equal to (a) until the initial funding thereof on the Closing Date, the aggregate amount of such Lender’s Commitments at such time, (b) thereafter, the sum of the aggregate then unpaid principal amount of such Lender’s Term Loans. “Aggregate Exposure Percentage”: as to any Lender at any time, the ratio (expressed as a percentage) of (a) such Lender’s Aggregate Exposure at such time to (b) the Aggregate Exposure of all Lenders at such time. “Agreement”: as defined in the preamble to this Agreement. “Agreement Currency”: as defined in Section 11.22. “All-in Yield”: as to any Indebtedness the yield thereof, solely in the form of interest rate, margin, original issue discount, upfront fees (solely to the extent in lieu of, and treated the same as, original issue discount), index floors or otherwise, in each case payable by the Borrower generally to Lenders; provided that (a) interest rate or margin shall be calculated solely at the time of Incurrence and after giving effect to the pricing “level” in any then-applicable pricing grid, which pricing “level” shall be determined at the time of Incurrence after giving Pro Forma Effect to any Indebtedness being Incurred on the date of calculation, (b) original issue discount and upfront fees shall be equated to interest rate assuming a four-year life to maturity, (c) at the election of the Borrower, with respect to any Indebtedness that includes a payable-in- kind election, the All-in Yield shall be calculated as if any payable-in-kind election is never made and (d) “All-in Yield” shall not include, at the election of the Borrower, (i) any credit spread or similar adjustment, (ii) call protection or premium, arrangement fees, structuring fees, underwriting fees, commitment fees, syndication fees, ticking fees, unused line fees, consent fees, amendment fees and similar fees or premiums (regardless of whether paid in whole or in part to the lenders) or (iii) any other fee or premium that is not paid generally to all relevant lenders ratably. In calculating the All-in Yield, if on the date of Incurrence of any applicable Indebtedness (including any Incremental Term Loans), such Indebtedness includes an interest rate floor that is greater than the interest rate floor applicable to the Initial Term Loans, such differential shall be added to the interest rate with respect to such Indebtedness for purposes of determining whether an increase to the interest rate margin under the Initial Term Loans shall be required (if applicable), but only to the extent that an increase in the interest rate floor would cause an increase to the interest rate margin then in effect with respect to such Initial Term Loans, solely for the purpose of determining the All- in Yield applicable to such Indebtedness and, in such case for purposes of the MFN Provision, the interest

 
3 rate floor (but not the interest rate margin) applicable to such Tranche of Initial Term Loans shall be increased to the extent of such differential between interest rate floors. “Ally Intercreditor Agreement”: that certain First Lien/Second Lien Intercreditor Agreement, dated September 1, 2023, by and among Carvana, LLC, the other grantors from time to time party thereto, Ally Bank, Ally Financial Inc., the U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, a national banking association, as trustee and as secured notes collateral agent and the other parties from time to time party thereto. “Alternative Currency”: (a) Euro, (b) Pounds Sterling, (c) Canadian Dollars, (d) any other currency added pursuant to this Agreement in the Incurrence or establishment of any Loan or Commitments hereunder, with notice to the Administrative Agent, and not otherwise prohibited herein. “Ancillary Fees”: as defined in Section 11.1(v). “Anti-Corruption Laws”: all laws, rules, and regulations of any jurisdiction applicable to the Borrower or its Subsidiaries from time to time concerning or relating to bribery or corruption. “Applicable Jurisdiction”: the United States (or any state or territory thereof) and any other jurisdiction approved by (a) the Borrower and (b) each of the Lenders of the applicable Tranche, acting reasonably and in good faith. “Applicable Margin”: as to Initial Term Loans, the rate per annum (a) for Term SOFR Rate Loans shall be 2.25%, and (b) for Base Rate Loans shall be 1.25%. Notwithstanding the foregoing, (v) the Applicable Margin in respect of any Tranche of Extended Loans shall be the applicable percentages per annum set forth in the relevant Extension Amendment, (w) the Applicable Margin in respect of any Tranche of Incremental Loans shall be the applicable percentages per annum set forth in the relevant Incremental Amendment, (x) the Applicable Margin in respect of any Tranche of Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness Incurred under this Agreement, shall be the applicable percentages per annum set forth in the relevant Refinancing Amendment or other relevant agreement and (y) in the case of the Initial Term Loans, the Applicable Margin may be increased as necessary to comply with the MFN Provision. “Approved Commercial Bank”: a commercial bank with a consolidated combined capital and surplus of at least $5,000,000,000. “Approved Foreign Bank”: as defined in the definition of “Cash Equivalents”. “Approved Fund”: (a) a CLO and (b) as to any Lender that is a fund which invests in commercial loans, any other fund that invests in commercial loans and is managed or advised by the same investment advisor as such Lender or by an Affiliate of such investment advisor. “Assignee”: as defined in Section 11.6(b)(i). “Assignment and Assumption”: an Assignment and Assumption, substantially in the form of Exhibit E-1 or any other form reasonably acceptable to the Borrower and the Administrative Agent. “Associate”: (a) any Person engaged in a Similar Business of which the Borrower or its Restricted Subsidiaries are the legal and beneficial owners of between 20.0% and 50.0% of all outstanding Voting Stock and (b) any joint venture entered into by the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary.

 
4 “Available Tenor”: as of any date of determination and with respect to the then-current Benchmark, as applicable, if such Benchmark is a term rate, any tenor for such Benchmark (or component thereof) that is or may be used for determining the length of an interest period pursuant to this Agreement as of such date and not including, for the avoidance of doubt, any tenor for such Benchmark that is then-removed from the definition of “Interest Period” pursuant to Section 4.7(d). “Bail-In Action”: the exercise of any Write-Down and Conversion Powers by the applicable Resolution Authority in respect of any liability of an Affected Financial Institution. “Bail-In Legislation”: (a) with respect to any EEA Member Country implementing Article 55 of Directive 2014/59/EU of the European Parliament and of the Council of the European Union, the implementing law, regulation, rule or requirement for such EEA Member Country from time to time that is described in the EU Bail-In Legislation Schedule and (b) with respect to the United Kingdom, Part I of the United Kingdom Banking Act 2009 (as amended from time to time) and any other law, regulation or rule applicable in the United Kingdom relating to the resolution of unsound or failing banks, investment firms or other financial institutions or their affiliates (other than through liquidation, administration or other insolvency proceedings). “Base Rate”: for any day, a fluctuating rate per annum equal to the highest of (a) the Federal Funds Effective Rate in effect for such day, plus 0.50%, (b) the Prime Rate in effect on such day and (c) the Term SOFR Rate applicable to Term SOFR Rate Loans denominated in Dollars for a one-month Interest Period on such day (or if such day is not a Business Day, the immediately preceding Business Day), plus 1.00%. Any change in such rate due to a change in the Prime Rate, the Federal Funds Effective Rate or the Term SOFR Rate applicable to Term SOFR Rate Loans denominated in Dollars shall be effective from and including the effective date of such change in the Prime Rate, the Federal Funds Effective Rate or the Term SOFR Rate applicable to Term SOFR Rate Loans denominated in Dollars, as the case may be. For the avoidance of doubt, if the Base Rate as determined pursuant to the foregoing would be less than 1.00% per annum, such rate shall be deemed to be 1.00% per annum for purposes of this Agreement. “Base Rate Loans”: Loans the rate of interest applicable to which is based upon the Base Rate. “Base Rate Term SOFR Determination Day”: as defined in the definition of “Term SOFR Rate”. “Benchmark”: initially, (a) with respect to Loans denominated in Dollars, the Term SOFR Reference Rate and (b) with respect to Loans denominated in any Alternative Currency, such other benchmark as determined by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower or the relevant Majority Facility Lenders and the Borrower; provided that if a Benchmark Transition Event has occurred with respect to the Term SOFR Reference Rate or the then-current Benchmark, then “Benchmark” means the applicable Benchmark Replacement to the extent that such Benchmark Replacement has replaced such prior benchmark rate pursuant to Section 4.7(b). “Benchmark Replacement”: for any Available Tenor, the sum of: (a) the alternate benchmark rate that has been selected by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower giving due consideration to (i) any selection or recommendation of a replacement benchmark rate or the mechanism for determining such a rate by the Relevant Governmental Body or (ii) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for determining a benchmark rate as a replacement to the then-current Benchmark for Dollar-denominated syndicated credit facilities at such time and (b) the related Benchmark Replacement Adjustment; provided that, if such Benchmark Replacement as so determined would be less than the Floor, such Benchmark Replacement will be deemed to be the Floor for the purposes of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents.

 
5 “Benchmark Replacement Adjustment”: as to any replacement of the then-current Benchmark with an Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement or any Interest Period and Available Tenor, the spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, (which may be a positive or negative value or zero) that has been selected by the Administrative Agent and the Borrower giving due consideration to (a) any selection or recommendation of a spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of such Benchmark with the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement by the Relevant Governmental Body or (b) any evolving or then-prevailing market convention for determining a spread adjustment, or method for calculating or determining such spread adjustment, for the replacement of such Benchmark with the applicable Unadjusted Benchmark Replacement for Dollar (or, to the extent applicable, the applicable Alternative Currency)-denominated syndicated credit facilities at such time. “Benchmark Replacement Date”: a date and time determined by the Administrative Agent and the Borrowers, which date shall be no later than the earliest to occur of the following events with respect to the then-current Benchmark: (a) in the case of clause (a) or (b) of the definition of “Benchmark Transition Event,” the later of (i) the date of the public statement or publication of information referenced therein and (ii) the date on which the administrator of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof) permanently or indefinitely ceases to provide such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); or (b) in the case of clause (c) of the definition of “Benchmark Transition Event,” the first date on which such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof) has been or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) have been determined and announced by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) to be non-representative; provided that such non-representativeness will be determined by reference to the most recent statement or publication referenced in such clause (c) and even if such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, any Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) continues to be provided on such date. For the avoidance of doubt, if such Benchmark is a term rate, the “Benchmark Replacement Date” will be deemed to have occurred in the case of clause (a) or (b) with respect to any Benchmark upon the occurrence of the applicable event or events set forth therein with respect to all then-current Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof). “Benchmark Transition Event”: as to any Benchmark, the occurrence of one or more of the following events with respect to the then-current Benchmark: (a) a public statement or publication of information by or on behalf of the administrator of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof) announcing that such administrator has ceased or will cease to provide such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof), permanently or indefinitely; provided that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, any Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); (b) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof), the Board, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, the central bank for the Alternative Currency applicable to such Benchmark, an insolvency official with jurisdiction over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such

 
6 component), a resolution authority with jurisdiction over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such component) or a court or an entity with similar insolvency or resolution authority over the administrator for such Benchmark (or such component), which states that the administrator of such Benchmark (or such component) has ceased or will cease to provide such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) permanently or indefinitely; provided that, at the time of such statement or publication, there is no successor administrator that will continue to provide such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, any Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or such component thereof); or (c) a public statement or publication of information by the regulatory supervisor for the administrator of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof) announcing that such Benchmark (or such component thereof) or, if such Benchmark is a term rate, all Available Tenors of such Benchmark (or such component thereof) are not, or as of a specified future date will not be, representative. For the avoidance of doubt, if such Benchmark is a term rate, a “Benchmark Transition Event” will be deemed to have occurred with respect to any Benchmark if a public statement or publication of information set forth above has occurred with respect to each then-current Available Tenor of such Benchmark (or the published component used in the calculation thereof). “Benchmark Unavailability Period”: the period (if any) (a) beginning at the time that a Benchmark Replacement Date has occurred if, at such time, no Benchmark Replacement has replaced the then-current Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in accordance with Section 4.7 and (b) ending at the time that a Benchmark Replacement has replaced the then-current Benchmark for all purposes hereunder and under any Loan Document in accordance with Section 4.7. “Beneficial Ownership Certificate”: a certification regarding beneficial ownership required by the Beneficial Ownership Regulation, which such certification shall be in form and substance substantially the same as the form of Certification Regarding Beneficial Owners of Legal Entity Customers published jointly, in May 2018, by the Loan Syndications and Trading Association and Securities Industry and Financial Markets Association (or such other form as the Borrower may otherwise agree). “Beneficial Ownership Regulation”: 31 C.F.R. § 1010.230. “Benefit Plan”: any of (a) an “employee benefit plan” (as defined in ERISA) that is subject to Title I of ERISA, (b) a “plan” as defined in and subject to Section 4975 of the Code or (c) any Person whose assets include (for purposes of ERISA Section 3(42) or otherwise for purposes of Title I of ERISA or Section 4975 of the Code) the assets of any such “employee benefit plan” or “plan”. “Benefited Lender”: as defined in Section 11.7(a). “BHC Act Affiliate”: of a party means an “affiliate” (as such term is defined under, and interpreted in accordance with, 12 U.S.C. 1841(k)) of such party. “Board”: the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System of the U.S. (or any successor thereof). “Board of Directors”: (a) with respect to any corporation, the board of directors or managers, as applicable, of the corporation, or any duly authorized committee thereof; (b) with respect to any partnership, the board of directors or managers or other governing body of the general partner, as applicable, of the partnership or any duly authorized committee thereof; (c) with respect to a limited liability company, the

 
7 managing member, members, manager or board of managers or any duly authorized controlling committee thereof; and (d) with respect to any other Person, the board or other analogous body or any duly authorized committee of such Person serving a similar function. Whenever any provision requires any action or determination to be made by, or any approval of, a Board of Directors, such action, determination or approval shall be deemed to have been taken or made if approved by a majority of the directors (or analogous position) on any such Board of Directors (whether or not such action or approval is taken as part of a formal board meeting or as a formal board approval). provided, however, that if as of 5:00 a.m. on any Periodic Term SOFR Determination Day the Term SOFR Reference Rate for the applicable tenor has not been published by the Term SOFR Administrator and a Benchmark Replacement Date with respect to the Term SOFR Reference Rate has not occurred, then Term SOFR Rate will be the Term SOFR Reference Rate for such tenor as published by the Term SOFR Administrator on the first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day for which such Term SOFR Reference Rate for such tenor was published by the Term SOFR Administrator so long as such first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day is not more than three (3) U.S. Government Securities Business Days prior to such Periodic Term SOFR Determination Day, and (b) for any calculation with respect to a Base Rate Loan on any day, the Term SOFR Reference Rate for a tenor of one month on the day (such day, the “Base Rate Term SOFR Determination Day”) that is two (2) U.S. Government Securities Business Days prior to such day, as such rate is published by the Term SOFR Administrator; provided, however, that if as of 5:00 p.m. on any Base Rate Term SOFR Determination Day the Term SOFR Reference Rate for the applicable tenor has not been published by the Term SOFR Administrator and a Benchmark Replacement Date with respect to the Term SOFR Reference Rate has not occurred, then Term SOFR Rate will be the Term SOFR Reference Rate for such tenor as published by the Term SOFR Administrator on the first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day for which such Term SOFR Reference Rate for such tenor was published by the Term SOFR Administrator so long as such first preceding U.S. Government Securities Business Day is not more than three (3) U.S. Government Securities Business Days prior to such Base Rate Term SOFR Determination Day; provided, further, that if Term SOFR Rate determined as provided above (including pursuant to the proviso under clause (a) or clause (b) above) shall ever be less than the Floor, then Term SOFR Rate shall be deemed to be the Floor. “Term SOFR Rate Loans”: Loans the rate of interest applicable to which is based upon the Term SOFR Rate. “Term SOFR Rate Tranche”: the collective reference to Term SOFR Rate Loans under a particular Facility for which the then current Interest Periods with respect to all of which begin on the same date and end on the same later date (whether or not such Loans shall originally have been made on the same day). “Term SOFR Reference Rate”: the forward-looking term rate based on SOFR. “Termination Date”: the date on which (a) the Commitments of all Lenders hereunder have been terminated or expired, and (b) all of the payment Obligations (other than Excluded Obligations) have been paid or performed in full. “Third Party Agent”: each of Alter Domus, SRS Acquiom, Ankura Trust, U.S. Bank Trust Company, Wilmington Trust (or in each case, an Affiliate thereof) or any other nationally recognized provider of comparable third-party agency services for credit facilities and other similar financings (as determined in good faith by the Borrower).

(a) Defined Terms in Loan Documents. Unless otherwise specified therein, all terms defined in this Agreement shall have the defined meanings when used in the other Loan Documents. (b) Interpretative Rules. With reference to this Agreement and each other Loan Document, unless otherwise specified herein or in such other Loan Document: (i) accounting terms relating to the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary not defined in Section 1.1 and accounting terms partly defined in Section 1.1, to the extent not defined, shall have the respective meanings given to them under GAAP, (ii) the words “include”, “includes” and “including” shall be deemed to be followed by the phrase “without limitation”, (iii) the words “asset” and “property” shall be construed to have the same meaning and effect and to refer to any and all tangible and intangible assets and properties of every type and nature, (iv) references to agreements or other Contractual Obligations shall, unless otherwise specified, be deemed to refer to such agreements or Contractual Obligations as amended, supplemented, restated or otherwise modified from time to time (subject to any applicable restrictions hereunder), (v) (A) the words “herein”, “hereto”, “hereof” and “hereunder” and words of similar import when used in any Loan Document shall refer to such Loan Document as a whole and not to any particular provision thereof and (B) the words “therein”, “thereto”, “thereof” and “thereunder” and words of similar import when used in any Loan Document shall refer to such other Loan Document as a whole and not to any particular provision thereof, (vi) (A) Article, Section, Clause, Paragraph, Exhibit and Schedule references are to the Loan Document in which such reference appears and (B) Article, Section, Clause, Paragraph, Exhibit and Schedule headings are for convenience of reference only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement or any other Loan Document, (vii) the meanings given to terms defined herein shall be equally applicable to both the singular and plural forms of such terms, (viii) the word “or” is not exclusive (which means “or” shall be equivalent to the use of “and/or”),

 
67 (ix) the term “documents” includes any and all instruments, documents, agreements, certificates, notices, reports, financial statements and other writings, however evidenced, whether in physical or electronic form, (x) in the computation of periods of time from a specified date to a later specified date, the word “from” means “from and including”; the words “to” and “until” each mean “to but excluding”; and the word “through” means “to and including”, (xi) all references to “knowledge” or “awareness” of any Loan Party or a Restricted Subsidiary means the actual knowledge of a Responsible Officer of such Loan Party or Restricted Subsidiary, (xii) all references to any Person shall be construed to include such Person’s successors and assigns (subject to any restriction on assignment set forth herein) and, in the case of any Governmental Authority, any other Governmental Authority that shall have succeeded to any or all of the functions thereof, (xiii) all references to “in the ordinary course of business” of the Borrower or any Subsidiary thereof means (i) in the ordinary course of business of, or in furtherance of an objective that is in the ordinary course of business of jurisdiction in which the Borrower or any Subsidiary does business, as applicable, or (iii) generally consistent with the past or current practice of the Borrower or such Subsidiary, as applicable, or Default, the words “exists”, “is continuing” or similar expressions with respect thereto shall mean that the Default or Event of Default has occurred and has not yet been cured or waived, (xv) unless of this Agreement and any other Loan Document, (xvi) the expressions “payment in full”, “paid in full” and any other similar terms or phrases when used herein with respect to any Obligation shall mean Subsidiary may, at the option of the Borrower, be those statements that are internally prepared or internally available and utilized for the stated purposes herein. (c) Clarification of Loans and Commitments. Commitments and Loans may be classified and referred to by Tranche (e.g., “Term Loans” or “Term Loan Tranche”) or by Type (e.g., “Term SOFR Rate Term Loans”). 1.3 Certain Calculations and Tests.

being Incurred in connection with such Specified Transaction is permitted to be Incurred in compliance with Section 2 or Section 8.2, as applicable, (2) whether any Lien being Incurred in connection with such Specified Transaction is permitted to be Incurred in accordance with Section 8.3 or the definition of “Permitted Liens”, (3) whether any Restricted Payment being made in connection with such Specified Transaction is permitted to be made in accordance with Section 8.7 or the definition of “Permitted Investments”, (4) whether any other transaction or action undertaken or proposed to be conditional, revocable or extendable), as applicable (as determined or elected by the Borrower), of such Specified Transaction is effective, delivered or entered into (as applicable, as determined or elected by the Borrower) (the “Transaction Commitment Date”) may be used as the applicable date of determination, as the case may be, in each case, with such pro forma adjustments as are appropriate and consistent with the pro forma adjustment provisions set forth in the definition of “Pro Forma Basis” (or equivalent definition), “Total Assets”, “Consolidated Total Assets”, “Consolidated EBITDA”, “TTM EBITDA” or in accordance with Section 1.3(c). For the avoidance of doubt, if the Borrower elects to use the Transaction Commitment Date as the applicable date of determination in accordance with the foregoing, (1) any fluctuation or change in any calculation of the ratios, baskets, thresholds, governors or financial metrics (including, in each case, any provisions or calculations related to or required or necessary to calculate for the same) (including the applicable exchange rate utilized in calculating compliance with any dollar-based provision of this Agreement or any other Loan Document), from the Transaction Commitment Date to the date of consummation of such Specified Transaction will not be taken into account for purposes of determining (x) whether any Indebtedness or Lien that is being Incurred in connection with such Specified Transaction is permitted to be Incurred, (y) compliance by the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary with any other provision of the Loan Documents or (z) whether such Specified Transaction is permitted to be Incurred, (2) for purposes of determining compliance with any provision which requires that no Default, Event of Default or specified Default or Event of Default, as applicable, has occurred, is continuing or would result from any such Specified Transaction, such condition shall be deemed satisfied so long as no Default, Event of Default or specified Default or Event of Default, as applicable, exists on the Transaction Commitment Date, (3) for purposes of determining whether the bring down of representations and warranties (or specified representations and warranties) in material respects (or another agreed standard thereof by the Borrower and requisite parties) on the Transaction Commitment Date, and (4) until such Specified Transaction is consummated or such withdrawn), such Specified Transaction and all transactions proposed to be undertaken in connection therewith (including the Incurrence of Indebtedness and Liens) will be given Pro Forma Effect when determining compliance of other transactions (including the Incurrence of Indebtedness and Liens unrelated to such Specified Transaction) that are consummated after the Transaction Commitment Date and on or prior to the date of consummation of such Specified Transaction and any such transactions (including any Incurrence of Indebtedness and the use of proceeds thereof) will be deemed to have occurred on the Transaction

 
69 Commitment Date and deemed to be outstanding thereafter for purposes of calculating any ratios, tests, thresholds or baskets under the Loan Documents after the Transaction Commitment Date and before the date of consummation of such Specified Transaction; provided that, if financial statements for one or more subsequent fiscal periods shall have become available, the Borrower may elect, in its sole discretion, to redetermine all such ratios, tests, thresholds or baskets on the basis of such financial statements, in which case such date of redetermination shall thereafter be deemed to be the applicable Transaction Commitment Date. Notwithstanding the foregoing provisions of this paragraph or any other provision of this Agreement or any other Loan Document, any unfunded Commitments outstanding at any time in respect of any Incremental Facility established pursuant to Section 4.17 to finance a Specified Transaction and any such transactions (including any Incurrence of Indebtedness and the use of proceeds thereof) on the applicable Transaction Commitment Date may be terminated only by the Lenders holding more than 50.0% of the aggregate amount of the Commitments in respect of such Incremental Facility (or by the Administrative Agent acting at the request of such Lenders), and not, for the avoidance of doubt, automatically or by the Required Lenders or any other Lenders (or by the Administrative Agent acting at the request of the Required Lenders or any other Lenders). For the avoidance of doubt, the Borrower shall be permitted to elect to utilize this Section 1.3(a) (solely to the extent in connection with a Specified Transaction), irrespective of whether any such ratio, test, basket or threshold described here expressly subjects the determination of such ratio, test, basket or threshold to this clause (a) or otherwise specifies a specific determination time or date with respect to such ratio, test, basket or threshold. (b) Basket Compliance Calculations. Notwithstanding anything herein or in any other Loan Document to the contrary, (i) if at any time any action or transaction meets the criteria of one or more than one of the categories of exceptions, thresholds or baskets set forth in any section of this Agreement or any definition used therein, the Borrower may divide, classify or designate such action or transaction (or any portion thereof), and later (on one or more occasions) may re-divide, re-classify or re-designate such action or transaction (or any portion thereof), as consummated in reliance on one or more of such exceptions, thresholds and baskets within such section or definition (or another section or definition, if permitted under this Agreement or any other Loan Document) of this Agreement or any definition used therein as the Borrower may determine in its sole discretion from time to time, including by re-dividing, re-classifying or re-designating any action or transaction originally consummated in reliance on one or more fixed exceptions, thresholds or baskets (including the Cumulative Credit Amount) (“fixed baskets”) as consummated in reliance on any available incurrence-based exception, threshold or basket (“incurrence- based baskets”) available at the time of such re-division, re-classification or re-designation (for the avoidance of doubt, which determination shall be made without duplication of such applicable action or transaction to be re-divided, re-classified or re-designated) and if any ratio, governor or financial test or other metric set forth in any applicable incurrence-based basket would be satisfied at any time after consummation of such action or transaction, such re-division, re-classification or re-designation shall be deemed to have automatically occurred if not elected by the Borrower (for the avoidance of doubt, without any action or consent from any other Person); provided that, in the absence of any intentional act or intentional omission on behalf of the Borrower, then any of the foregoing items shall be deemed to be automatically (for the avoidance of doubt, without any action or consent from any other Person) divided, designated or classified (or, if applicable or necessary, re-divided, re-designated or re-classified) in such a manner that at all times maximizes the amount of basket capacity available to the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries under the Loan Documents and provides the maximum flexibility and capacity with respect to the terms, conditions and covenants under the Loan Documents in favor of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries so long as not otherwise prohibited under this Agreement; provided, further, that all Indebtedness consisting of Obligations under this Agreement Incurred on or after the Closing Date shall be deemed to have been Incurred pursuant to Section 8.2(a) and all Guarantees of the foregoing will be deemed to have been Incurred pursuant to Section 8.2(a), and the Borrower shall not be permitted to reclassify all or any portion of Indebtedness Incurred pursuant to Section 8.2(a); provided, further, unless otherwise expressly required under this Agreement, (x) in no event shall the Borrower be required to

 
70 calculate or otherwise report compliance with any such exception, threshold, basket, ratio, financial test or other metric to the Administrative Agent or other Secured Party and (y) any division, classification, designation (or re-division, re-classification or re-designation) may be retroactively determined from time to time to ensure compliance with the Loan Documents; and (ii) if any fixed baskets are intended to be utilized together with any incurrence-based exceptions, thresholds or baskets in any action or transaction (for the avoidance of doubt, without any action or consent from any other Person), (A) compliance with or satisfaction of any applicable any ratio, governor or financial test or other metric for such action or transaction (or any portion thereof) to be consummated under any incurrence-based baskets shall first be calculated without giving effect to amounts being utilized pursuant to any fixed baskets, but giving full Pro Forma Effect to all applicable and related transactions (including, subject to the foregoing with respect to fixed baskets, any Incurrence and repayments of Indebtedness) and all other permitted pro forma adjustments, and (B) thereafter, Incurrence of the portion of such action or transaction to be consummated under any fixed baskets shall be calculated. No effect shall be given to any concurrent or substantially simultaneous borrowing under any revolving credit facility, working capital facility or floor plan facility in the calculation of any incurrence-based baskets. (c) Pro Forma Calculations. Notwithstanding anything herein or in any other Loan Document to the contrary, (i) the Consolidated Interest Expense, Consolidated EBITDA, Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, Consolidated Interest Expense, Consolidated Net Income, Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Total Assets, Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, TTM EBITDA, Total Assets, Fixed Charges or Pro Forma Cost Savings of the Borrower shall be calculated on a Pro Forma Basis with respect to each Specified Transaction occurring during the applicable four quarter period to which such calculation relates, or subsequent to the end of such four- quarter period (including, with respect to any proposed Investment or acquisition pursuant to Rule 2.7 of The City Code on Takeovers and Mergers (or a similar arrangement) for which committed financing is obtained or is sought to be obtained, the relevant determination or calculation may be made with respect to an event occurring or intended to occur subsequent to such four-quarter period), (ii) for purposes of calculating any leverage ratio herein in connection with the Incurrence of any Indebtedness, there shall be no netting of the cash proceeds proposed to be received in connection with the Incurrence of such Indebtedness; provided that, for the avoidance of doubt, any cash or Cash Equivalents earned, acquired or received or proposed to be earned, acquired or received in connection with any acquisition, Investment, Disposition or other transaction may be netted for purposes of calculating such leverage ratio, (iii) if since the beginning of any applicable four-quarter period, any Person that subsequently became a Restricted Subsidiary or was merged, amalgamated or consolidated with or into the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary since the beginning of such four-quarter period shall have made any Specified Transaction that would have required adjustment pursuant to this Section 1.3(c), then such financial ratio or test shall be calculated to give Pro Forma Effect thereto in accordance with this Section 1.3(c) and (iv) in calculating the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio or Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, the Borrower shall have the option to treat any revolving facility or delayed draw term facility then being established (or, in each case, the amount of any increase thereof) as fully drawn at the time of establishing such revolving commitment or delayed draw term commitments, as applicable, and, if such Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio or Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, as applicable, is satisfied with respect thereto at such time of establishment, any subsequent borrowing or other Incurrence thereunder, not in excess of the aggregate amount attributable to such revolving facility or delayed draw term facility, as applicable, and included in such calculation, shall not be deemed as an Incurrence of additional Indebtedness at such subsequent time and shall not be required to satisfy such applicable ratio at such subsequent time. 1.4 Divisions. For all purposes under the Loan Documents, in connection with any division or plan of division under Delaware law (or any comparable event under a different jurisdiction’s laws): (a)

 
71 any reference to a merger, transfer, consolidation, amalgamation, assignment, sale, disposition or transfer, or similar term, shall be deemed to apply to a division of or by a limited liability company, or an allocation of assets to a series of a limited liability company (or the unwinding of such a division or allocation), as if it were a merger, transfer, consolidation, amalgamation, assignment, sale, disposition or transfer, or similar term, as applicable, to, of or with a separate Person and (b) any division of a limited liability company shall constitute a separate Person hereunder (and each division of any limited liability company that is a Subsidiary, joint venture or any other like term shall also constitute such a Person or entity). 1.5 Interest Rates. The Administrative Agent does not warrant or accept responsibility for, and shall not have any liability with respect to, in each case, except as a result of the Administrative Agent’s willful misconduct, bad faith, fraud or gross negligence or as expressly set forth in this Agreement, (a) the continuation of, administration of, submission of, calculation of or any other matter related to Base Rate, the Term SOFR Reference Rate or Term SOFR Rate, or any component definition thereof or rates referred to in the definition thereof, or any alternative, successor or replacement rate thereto (including any Benchmark Replacement), including whether the composition or characteristics of any such alternative, successor or replacement rate (including any Benchmark Replacement) will be similar to, or produce the same value or economic equivalence of, or have the same volume or liquidity as, Base Rate, the Term SOFR Reference Rate, Term SOFR Rate or any other Benchmark prior to its discontinuance or unavailability, or (b) the effect, implementation or composition of any Conforming Changes. The Administrative Agent and its affiliates or other related entities may engage in transactions that affect the calculation of Base Rate, the Term SOFR Reference Rate, Term SOFR Rate, any alternative, successor or replacement rate (including any Benchmark Replacement) or any relevant adjustments thereto, in each case, in a manner adverse to the Borrower. The Administrative Agent may select information sources or services in its reasonable discretion to ascertain Base Rate, the Term SOFR Reference Rate, Term SOFR Rate or any other Benchmark, in each case pursuant to the terms of this Agreement, and shall have no liability, in each case, except as a result of the Administrative Agent’s willful misconduct, bad faith, fraud or gross negligence or as expressly set forth in this Agreement, to the Borrower, any Lender or any other person or entity for damages of any kind, including direct or indirect, special, punitive, incidental or consequential damages, costs, losses or expenses (whether in tort, contract or otherwise and whether at law or in equity), for any error or calculation of any such rate (or component thereof) provided by any such information source or service. 1.6 Cashless Rollovers. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document, to the extent that any Lender extends the maturity date of, or replaces, renews or refinances, any of its then-existing Loans with Incremental Loans, Refinancing Term Loans, Extended Loans or loans or notes Incurred under a new credit facility or indenture, as applicable, in each case, to the extent such extension, replacement, renewal or refinancing is effected by means of a “cashless roll” by such Lender, such extension, replacement, renewal or refinancing shall be deemed to comply with any requirement hereunder or any other Loan Document that such payment be made “in immediately available funds”, “in cash” or any other similar requirement. 1.7 Exchange Rates; Currency Equivalents. (a) General. The Administrative Agent shall determine the Exchange Rates as of each Valuation Date to be used for calculating Dollar Equivalent amounts of extensions of credit and amounts outstanding hereunder denominated in other Alternative Currencies. Such Exchange Rates shall become effective as of such Valuation Date and shall be the Exchange Rates employed in converting any amounts between the applicable currencies until the next Valuation Date to occur. Except for purposes of financial statements delivered by the Borrower hereunder or except as otherwise provided herein, the applicable amount of any currency (other than Dollars) for purposes of the Loan Documents shall be the Dollar Equivalent of such currency as so determined by the Administrative Agent.

 
72 (b) Borrowings, Credit Extensions, Etc. Whenever in this Agreement in connection with a borrowing, conversion, continuation or prepayment of a Term SOFR Rate Loan, an amount, such as a required minimum or multiple amount, is expressed in Dollars, but such borrowing, Term SOFR Rate Loan is denominated in another Alternative Currency, such amount shall be the relevant Foreign Currency Equivalent of such Dollar Equivalent (rounded to the nearest unit of such other alternative Currency, with 0.5 or a unit being rounded upward), as determined by the Administrative Agent. (c) Ratio Compliance. For purposes of determining compliance with the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio, Consolidated Secured Net Leverage Ratio or Consolidated Total Net Leverage Ratio, the amount of any Indebtedness denominated in any currency other than Dollars will be converted into Dollars based on the relevant currency exchange rate in effect on the date of the financial statements on which the applicable Consolidated EBITDA is calculated. (d) Alternative Currency. For the avoidance of doubt, in the case of a Loan denominated in an Alternative Currency, except as expressly provided herein, all interest and fees shall accrue and be payable thereon based on the actual amount outstanding in such Alternative Currency (without any translation into the Dollar Equivalent thereof). 1.8 Rounding. Any financial ratios required to be maintained by the Borrower pursuant to this Agreement (or required to be satisfied in order for a specific action to be permitted under this Agreement) shall be calculated by dividing the appropriate component by the other component, carrying the result to one (1) place more than the number of places by which such ratio is expressed herein and rounding the result up or down to the nearest number (with a rounding up if there is no nearest number). 1.9 References to Agreements, Laws, Etc. Unless otherwise expressly provided herein, (a) references to Organizational Documents, agreements (including the Loan Documents) and other Contractual Obligations shall be deemed to include all subsequent amendments, refinancings, restatements, amendments and restatements, renewals, restructurings, extensions, supplements and other modifications thereto, but only to the extent that such amendments, refinancings, restatements, amendments and restatements, renewals, restructurings, extensions, supplements and other modifications are not prohibited by the Loan Documents or by the Intercreditor Agreements; and (b) references to any law shall include all statutory and regulatory provisions consolidating, amending, restating, amending and restating, replacing, supplementing, modifying or interpreting such law. Any term or section reference herein or in the other Loan Documents which refers to a defined term or section reference in any Organizational Document, agreement, Contractual Obligation or law shall be deemed to be a cross-reference to the same or comparable defined term or section reference, as applicable, in any such amendment, refinancing, restatement, amendment and restatement, renewal, restructuring, extension, supplement or other modification to such Organizational Document, agreement, Contractual Obligation or any such consolidation, amendment, replacement, supplement or interpretation of such law. 1.10 Times of Day. Unless otherwise specified, all references herein to times of day shall be references to New York City time (daylight or standard, as applicable). 1.11 Timing of Payment or Performance. Unless otherwise specified, when the payment of any obligation or the performance of any covenant, duty or obligation is stated to be due or performance required on a day which is not a Business Day, the date of such payment or performance shall extend to the immediately succeeding Business Day. 1.12 Borrower Representative; Attorney-In-Fact. Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document to the contrary, (i) each Co-Borrower (if any) hereby irrevocably appoints the Carvana Borrower (and the Carvana Borrower hereby accepts such appointment) as the

 
73 borrowing agent and attorney-in-fact for such Co-Borrower, which appointment shall remain in full force and effect unless and until the Administrative Agent shall have received prior written notice signed by such Co-Borrowers (or, if only concerning the Co-Borrowers, the Co-Borrowers (other than the Carvana Borrower or its permitted successor hereunder)) that such appointment has been revoked and that another Borrower has been appointed in the place of the Carvana Borrower, (ii) each Co-Borrower hereby irrevocably appoints and authorizes the Carvana Borrower (A) to provide to the Administrative Agent, any Lender or any Secured Party and receive from the Administrative Agent, any Lender or any Secured Party, all notices (including borrowing notices) with respect to Loans obtained for the benefit of each Co-Borrower and all other notices, certificates (including Compliance Certificates, solvency certificates and customary closing certificates), communications and instructions under this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, (B) to request, execute and deliver amendments, waivers, consents, notices, certificates and any other documents and deliverables required or requested in accordance with this Agreement and the other Loan Documents (including binding any Co-Borrower in respect of the obligations thereunder) and (C) to take such action as the Carvana Borrower deems appropriate on its behalf to obtain Loans or Commitments and to exercise such other powers as are reasonably incidental thereto to carry out the purposes of this Agreement and the other Loan Documents (it being further understood, for the avoidance of doubt and notwithstanding anything herein to the contrary, that (1) the Carvana Borrower may act for and on behalf of any Co-Borrower (individually or in the aggregate) for all purposes of this Agreement and any other Loan Document that requires any Co-Borrower to certify, execute, identify, deliver, request, consult, consent, reaffirm, represent, warrant, covenant, determine, calculate, select, elect, estimate, notify or otherwise take action notwithstanding anything in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document to the contrary, (2) the judgment of Carvana Borrower, acting for and on behalf of the Co-Borrowers (individually or in the aggregate) shall be controlling and definitive and (3) the Carvana Borrower shall not be required to consult or obtain the consent of any Co-Borrower to act in accordance with this Section 1.12), (iii) it is understood that the handling of the Collateral of the Co-Borrowers in a combined fashion, as more fully set forth herein and in the Security Documents, is done solely as an accommodation to the Borrowers and the Subsidiary Guarantors in order to utilize the collective borrowing powers of the Borrowers in the most efficient and economical manner and at their request, and that neither the Administrative Agent nor the Lenders shall incur liability to any Loan Party as a result hereof, and (iv) each Borrower expects to derive benefit, directly or indirectly, from the handling of the Collateral in a combined fashion since the successful operation of each Borrower is dependent on the continued successful performance of the integrated group. For the avoidance of doubt, unless otherwise required from the context or expressly stated herein or in any other Loan Document, the agreements set forth in this Section 1.12 shall not be impaired by a reference to one or more other Borrower or other Loan Parties. Upon the accession of any other Loan Party in accordance with this Agreement and the other Loan Documents, such Loan Party shall be deemed to have consented to this Section 1.12 (unless otherwise prohibited by applicable law), and each reference to a “Co- Borrower” or “Borrower” in this Section 1.12 shall be deemed to include a reference to such Loan Party (solely for the purposes of this Section 1.12), irrespective if such Person is a Co-Borrower or a Subsidiary Guarantor. 1.13 Covenant Fallaway. Notwithstanding anything in this Agreement or in any other Loan Document to the contrary, Section 8.7 (including, for the avoidance of doubt, any restriction therein) shall be deemed to no longer apply to the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary in any respect (unless the Borrower shall determine to the contrary), without any action from any Person, on and after the date on which Investment Grade Status has been achieved so long as, as of the date of such achievement (which such date shall be determined by the Borrower in good faith), no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing (this paragraph, the “Covenant Fallaway”). SECTION 2. AMOUNT AND TERMS OF COMMITMENTS AND LOANS 2.1 Commitments and Loans.

 
74 (a) Closing Date Commitments and Loans. Subject to the terms and conditions hereof, (a) each Initial Term Lender severally agrees to make a Term Loan denominated in Dollars to the Borrower on the Closing Date in an amount not to exceed the amount of such Initial Term Lender’s Initial Term Commitment as of the Closing Date. Initial Term Loans shall be either Term SOFR Rate Loans or Base Rate Loans, as determined by the Borrower and notified to the Administrative Agent in accordance with Sections 2.2 and 4.3. The Initial Term Commitments shall automatically terminate upon funding of the Initial Term Loans on the Closing Date. Amounts borrowed under this Section 2.1(a) and subsequently repaid or prepaid may not be reborrowed (it being understood, however, that prepayments will be taken into account for purposes of any Prepayment-Based Incremental Facility to the extent provided for in this Agreement). (b) Other Commitments and Loans. After the Closing Date, subject to and upon the terms and conditions set forth herein, each Lender with a Term Commitment (other than an Initial Term Commitment) with respect to any Tranche of Term Loans (other than Initial Term Loans) severally agrees to make a Term Loan denominated in Dollars (or, to the extent agreed to among the Borrower and the applicable Lenders under such Tranche, an Alternative Currency) under such Tranche to the Borrower in an amount not to exceed such Term Lender’s Term Commitment under such Tranche on the date of incurrence thereof, which Term Loans under such Tranche shall be incurred pursuant to a single drawing on the date set forth for such incurrence. Such Term Loans may be Base Rate Loans, Term SOFR Rate Loans, Loans bearing a fixed interest rate or, with respect to Loans denominated in an Alternative Currency in a benchmark applicable to such Alternative Currency, in each case, as further provided herein or as agreed to by the Borrower and the applicable Lenders. Once repaid, Term Loans incurred hereunder may not be reborrowed (it being understood, however, that prepayments will be taken into account for purposes of any Prepayment-Based Incremental Facility to the extent provided for in this Agreement). 2.2 Procedure for the Term Loan Borrowings. (a) General Procedures. The Borrower shall give the Administrative Agent notice (which any such notice in the form of the Committed Loan Notice shall be acceptable and which may be delivered by email) with respect to any borrowing of Term Loans, which (i) with respect to any borrowing of Initial Term Loans, such notice must be received by the Administrative Agent prior to 5:00 p.m. one (1) Business Day prior to the anticipated Closing Date (or such shorter period as the Administrative Agent may agree), requesting that the Initial Term Lenders make Initial Term Loans on the Closing Date, the type of Loans to be borrowed, the Interest Period (if applicable) and specifying the amount to be borrowed or (ii) with respect to any borrowing of any Term Loans (other than Initial Term Loans), such notice must be received by the Administrative Agent prior to (A) for Term SOFR Rate Loans or for any Loan denominated in an Alternative Currency, 12:00 p.m. three (3) Business Days prior to the anticipated date of borrowing (or such shorter period as the Administrative Agent (or, to the extent applicable, the Incremental Arranger or the Extended Tranche Arranger) may agree) and (B) for Base Rate Loans, 11:00 a.m. on the date of borrowing (or such shorter period as the Administrative Agent (or, to the extent applicable, the Incremental Arranger or the Extended Tranche Arranger) may agree), in each case, requesting that the Term Lenders make Term Loans on an expected future date, the type of Loans to be borrowed, the Interest Period (if applicable) and specifying the amount to be borrowed. Upon receipt of such notice, the Administrative Agent shall promptly notify each Initial Term Lender thereof. Any such notice delivered pursuant to this Section 2.2(a) may, at the election of the Borrower, be conditional, extendable or revocable upon the occurrence or non-occurrence of any event or act. Not later than (A) 12:00 p.m. on the Closing Date, each Initial Term Lender shall make available to the Administrative Agent at the Funding Office an amount in immediately available funds equal to the Initial Term Loans to be made by such Initial Term Lender and (B) 2:00 p.m. on the Closing Date (or such later time as the Borrower may agree), each Term Lender shall make available to the Administrative Agent at the Funding Office an amount in immediately available funds equal to the Term Loans to be made by such Term Lender. The failure of any Lender to make the Loan to

 
75 be made by it as part of any borrowing shall not relieve any other Lender of its obligation, if any, hereunder to make its Loan on the date of such borrowing. For the avoidance of doubt, to the extent the Borrower establishes any Incremental Revolving Facility, the Borrower and the Administrative Agent may amend this Section 2.2(a) to provide for additional procedures to borrow such Loans. (b) Borrower’s Account. The Administrative Agent shall credit the account of the Borrower on the books of such office of the Administrative Agent with the aggregate amounts made available to the Administrative Agent by the Initial Term Lenders in immediately available funds. 2.3 Repayment of Initial Term Loans. The Borrower shall repay to the Administrative Agent for the ratable benefit of the applicable Lenders on the Initial Term Facility Maturity Date the aggregate principal balance of all Initial Term Loans outstanding on such date. The Borrower shall also repay prior to the Initial Term Facility Maturity Date in consecutive quarterly installments to the Administrative Agent for the ratable account of the Initial Term Lenders, each of which shall be in an amount equal to such Lender’s Term Percentage of 0.25% of the original aggregate principal amount of the Initial Term Loans outstanding on the Closing Date after giving effect to Section 2.1 hereof (which installments shall, to the extent applicable, be (x) reduced as a result of the application of prepayments in accordance with the order of priority set forth in Sections 4.1, 4.2 and 4.20 or other adjustment pursuant to Section 11.7 (including, for the avoidance of doubt, with respect to any purchases (including “open market purchase”), payments, redemptions, buybacks (including Dutch auctions) or exchanges), or (y) increased as a result of any increase in the amount of Initial Term Loans pursuant to Section 4.17 (such increased amortization payments to be calculated in the same manner (and on the same basis))), commencing with the fiscal quarter ending March 31, 2027. For the avoidance of doubt, the repayment terms of any Incremental Commitments, Incremental Loans, Loans of any Extended Tranche, Loans in respect of Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness incurred under this Agreement, in each case, shall be set forth in the amendment documentation to this Agreement (or the similar thereof) governing such Loans. All Loans shall be repaid, whether pursuant to this Section 2.3 or otherwise, in the currency in which they were made. SECTION 3. CO-BORROWER ARRANGEMENTS 3.1 Addition of Co-Borrowers. From time to time on or after the Closing Date, the Carvana Borrower (or any successor “Borrower Representative” appointed in accordance with Section 1.12) may designate one or more Wholly Owned Restricted Subsidiaries as a “Co-Borrower” with respect to any designated Tranche under any Term Facility or any Incremental Revolving Facility; provided that such Restricted Subsidiary designated after the Closing Date shall not become a Co-Borrower hereunder unless and until each of the following has occurred or is satisfied, as applicable: (a) KYC, PATRIOT Act, Etc. The Administrative Agent (for itself and any requesting Lender) shall have received a Beneficial Ownership Certificate and all other documentation and other information about such Co-Borrower as has been reasonably requested in writing by such Lenders that they reasonably determine is required by regulatory authorities under applicable “know your customer” and Anti-Money Laundering Laws, including the PATRIOT Act and Beneficial Ownership Regulation. (b) Applicable Jurisdiction and Tax Consequences. Such Co-Borrower shall (i) be organized in an Applicable Jurisdiction and (ii) not, by its designation as a Co-Borrower, cause a material adverse tax consequence for the Lenders in the aggregate (as compared to the position of the Lenders in the aggregate before the designation of such Co-Borrower). (c) No Event of Default. No Event of Default shall exist and be continuing or would result from such proposed Restricted Subsidiary being designated as a Co-Borrower.

 
76 (d) Representations and Warranties. The representations and warranties of such Co-Borrower contained in Section 5 or any other Loan Document shall be true and correct in all material respects (and in all respects if any such representation or warranty is already qualified by materiality after giving effect to such qualification) on and as of the date of designation of any Co-Borrower, except to the extent that such representations and warranties specifically refer to an earlier date, in which case they shall be true and correct in all material respects (and in all respects if any such representation or warranty is already qualified by materiality after giving effect to such qualification). (e) Guarantee Requirements. Such Co-Borrower shall have delivered to the Administrative Agent (or its counsel) a duly authorized, executed and delivered counterpart signature page to a Co- Borrower Joinder Agreement and, if applicable, applicable Intercreditor Agreement and a guaranty or guaranty supplement pursuant to the Guarantee Agreement; provided that such Co-Borrower Joinder Agreement and such guaranty or guaranty supplement will incorporate any provisions specific to the designated Co-Borrower’s jurisdiction of organization and applicable laws of such jurisdiction of organization. (f) Collateral Requirements. Such Co-Borrower shall have delivered to the Administrative Agent (or its counsel) executed counterparts of a joinder or supplement to and a security agreement or supplement pursuant to the Security Agreement, together with other deliverables reasonably required pursuant to such Section as applied to such Co-Borrower (it being understood and agreed that the Administrative Agent and the Borrower may waive or modify any such requirements to the extent they deem in their mutual discretion such changes are necessary or appropriate under the circumstances taking into account the designated Co-Borrower’s jurisdiction of organization and applicable laws). (g) Authorizations. The Administrative Agent (or its counsel) shall have received a copy of a resolution of the Board of Directors, if required by applicable law, of such Co-Borrower: (i) approving the terms of, and the transactions contemplated by, the Loan Documents to which it is a party and resolving that it execute, deliver and perform the Loan Documents to which it is a party; (ii) authorizing a specified Person or Persons to execute the Loan Documents and any related documents to which it is a party on its behalf; and (iii) authorizing a specified Person or Persons, on its behalf, to sign or dispatch all documents and notices (including, if relevant, any Committed Loan Notice or other relevant notice) to be signed or dispatched by it under or in connection with the Loan Documents to which it is a party. (h) Organizational Documents. The Administrative Agent (or its counsel) shall have received a certificate of a Responsible Officer of the Co-Borrower certifying that its Organizational Documents and each copy document relating to it specified in clause (g) above, is correct, complete and in full force and effect and has not been amended or superseded as at a date no earlier than the date of such Co-Borrower Joinder Agreement. (i) Legal Opinion. To the extent requested of the Borrower by the Administrative Agent, the Administrative Agent (or its counsel) shall have received a customary legal opinion from counsel to the Co-Borrower. 3.2 Status of Co-Borrowers. Once a Co-Borrower has become a Co-Borrower in accordance with Section 3.1, it shall be a “Borrower” under any Facility (with respect to the applicable Tranche), as applicable, and with respect to any Borrower under any Incremental Revolving Facility, will have the right to directly request Incremental Revolving Loans in accordance with this Agreement, or the date on which such Co-Borrower terminates its obligations under this Agreement in accordance with Section 3.3 or the date on which such Co-Borrower is released from its obligations under the Loan Documents in accordance with this Agreement and the other applicable Loan Documents, including Section 11.14. Each of the Co-

 
77 Borrowers and the applicable Borrower shall hereby accept joint and several liability hereunder with respect to the Obligations under the applicable Tranche of the applicable Facility under the Loan Documents. 3.3 Resignation of Co-Borrowers. A Co-Borrower may elect to terminate its eligibility to request borrowings under this Agreement and to cease to be a Co-Borrower hereunder upon the occurrence of, and such resignation shall be effective upon, all of the following: (a) Obligations. Such resigning Co-Borrower shall have paid in full in cash all of its direct Obligations (other than the Excluded Obligations) hereunder or such other Co-Borrowers or Carvana Borrower shall have assumed such amounts. (b) Notice. Such resigning Co-Borrower shall have delivered to the Administrative Agent a notice of resignation in form and substance reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent; provided, however, that such resignation shall not, to the extent applicable, have any impact on such Person’s obligations as a Subsidiary Guarantor and such obligations, to the extent applicable, shall continue to be effective in accordance with the Guarantee Agreement and the other provisions and undertakings hereunder related thereto. For the avoidance of doubt, the Co-Borrower shall not be required to adhere to the above in connection with a release pursuant to Section 11.14. SECTION 4. GENERAL PROVISIONS APPLICABLE TO LOANS 4.1 Optional Prepayments. (a) General Procedures for Optional Prepayments. The Borrower may at any time and from time to time prepay the Loans, in whole or in part, without premium or penalty (except as set forth in clause (c) below), upon notice (which any such notice in the form of the Optional Prepayment Notice shall be acceptable and which may be delivered by email) delivered to the Administrative Agent (i) no later than 1:00 p.m. three (3) Business Days prior thereto (or such later date or time as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) in the case of Term SOFR Rate Loans or any Loan denominated in an Alternative Currency and (ii) and no later than 1:00 p.m. one (1) Business Day prior thereto (or such later date or time as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) in the case of Base Rate Loans, in each case which notice shall specify the date and amount of prepayment and whether the prepayment is of Term SOFR Rate Loans or Base Rate Loans and the currency of the Loan being repaid. Upon receipt of any such notice the Administrative Agent shall promptly notify each relevant Lender thereof. If any such notice is given, the amount specified in such notice shall be due and payable on the date specified therein (provided that such notice may state that such notice is conditional, extendable or revocable upon the occurrence or non-occurrence of any event or act), together with accrued interest to such date on the amount prepaid. Partial prepayments of Term Loans shall be in an aggregate principal amount in a minimum amount of (A) the lesser of $500,000 (or such smaller amount as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent amount to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any Tranche that may be prepaid under this Section 4.1(a) and (B) to the extent in excess of the minimum amount set forth in clause (A), in integrals in excess thereof equal to the lesser of $500,000 (or such smaller amount as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any increase that may be requested under this Section 4.1(a). (b) Application of Optional Prepayments. Any optional prepayments of the Term Facilities pursuant to Section 4.1(a) shall be applied to the Tranche of Term Loan designated in such notice of prepayment on a pro rata basis among the Term Lenders within such Tranche (which may be either directed at the principal balance or credited to the remaining scheduled installment of such Term Loans within such Tranche) or, to the extent the Borrower has not specified the applicable Tranche in such notice of

 
78 prepayment, such optional prepayment shall be credited pro rata to the remaining scheduled installments of the Term Facilities (in direct order of maturity) thereof and thereafter pro rata to the remaining principal balance of the Term Facilities (in direct order of maturity). All Loans shall be repaid, whether pursuant to this Section 4.1 or otherwise, in the currency in which they were made. (c) Prepayment Premium. Notwithstanding the foregoing, a prepayment premium shall apply to any prepayment of Initial Term Loans pursuant to Section 4.1(a) resulting in a Repricing Transaction or effecting an amendment with respect to Initial Term Loans resulting in a Repricing Transaction, in each case, occurring on or prior to the six month anniversary of the Closing Date from the proceeds of a Repricing Transaction in an amount equal to 1.00% of the principal amount of the Initial Term Loans subject to such prepayment or, in the case of any Repricing Transaction effected through an amendment, the principal amount of Initial Term Loans outstanding immediately prior to such amendment of any Term Lender that is replaced in connection with such amendment pursuant to the Borrower’s exercise of its mandatory assignment rights to replace a Lender under Section 4.13, which, to the extent the foregoing applies, the Borrower shall pay such prepayment premium to the Administrative Agent for the ratable account of the applicable Term Lenders holding such affected Initial Term Loans (excluding any Term Lender that has waived or otherwise deferred such prepayment premium (solely as to such Term Lender)). 4.2 Mandatory Prepayments. (a) Prohibited Indebtedness. If at any time after the Closing Date the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary receives any Net Cash Proceeds from the Incurrence of any Indebtedness (other than Indebtedness permitted by Section 8.2 (except the Net Cash Proceeds of any Permitted Pari Passu Refinancing Debt, Permitted Junior Refinancing Debt, Permitted Unsecured Refinancing Debt or other Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness)), the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans (excluding any Term Loans the terms of which do not apply such prepayment) on a pro rata basis on or prior to the date that is five (5) Business Days after such receipt in an amount equal to 100.0% of such Net Cash Proceeds. (b) Dispositions and Recovery Events of Collateral. If at any time after the Closing Date any Loan Party receives any Net Cash Proceeds from any individual Relevant Dispositions (or series of related Relevant Dispositions) or any individual Relevant Recovery Event (or series of related Relevant Recovery Events), in each case, in an amount exceeding the greater of $540,000,000 and 20.0% of TTM EBITDA (the “Relevant Threshold”) (and only Net Cash Proceeds in excess of the Relevant Threshold (after giving effect to the reinvestment rights set forth herein) shall constitute Net Cash Proceeds under this Section 4.2(b)), then (except to the extent the Borrower reinvests or intends or expects to reinvest such Net Cash Proceeds in accordance with this Section 4.2) the Borrower shall prepay the Term Loans (excluding any Term Loans the terms of which do not apply such prepayment) on a pro rata basis on the tenth Business Day after the date of such receipt in an amount equal to 100.0% of such excess Net Cash Proceeds (provided, further, that such percentage shall be reduced from 100.0% to 50.0% and to 0.0% if, on a Pro Forma Basis after giving effect to such Relevant Disposition or Relevant Recovery Event (which the Borrower shall be permitted to elect test or re-test at any time during any reinvestment period), as the case may be, and the use of proceeds therefrom, the Consolidated First Lien Net Leverage Ratio would be equal to or less than 2.75 to 1.00 or 1.75 to 1.00, respectively); provided that, if the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary uses an amount equal to any portion of such proceeds to reinvest in the business of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary, including to invest in, acquire, maintain, develop, construct, improve, upgrade or repair assets (including working capital assets) in the business of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary or to make any acquisition or Investment not prohibited hereunder (or any subsequent acquisition or Investment made in a Person, division or line of business previously acquired), capital expenditure or capitalized software expenditures, in each case, within twenty-four (24) months of such receipt (or credited against any such usage consummated within six (6) months prior to the consummation of the applicable Relevant Disposition or the occurrence of the applicable Relevant Recovery Event), such
