maximum aggregate principal amount then permitted to be incurred in reliance on the Inside Maturity Basket, in each case, may (1) have a maturity date earlier than the Latest Maturity Date for the Initial Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness and (2) have a Weighted Average Life to Maturity shorter than the remaining Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the Initial Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness; (ii) except as set forth in the succeeding paragraph and subclause (f)(iv) below with respect to the All-in Yield applicable to any Incremental Term Facility described therein (including subject to any exceptions described herein) and as set forth in subclause (d)(i)(D) above with respect to final maturity and Weighted Average Life to Maturity of any Incremental Term Facility, any such Incremental Term Facility shall have such terms (including with respect to certain documentary conditions precedent) as are agreed to by the Borrower and the Incremental Arranger; and (iii) shall be denominated in Dollars, Canadian Dollars, Euro, Pounds Sterling or another currency reasonably acceptable

 
97 to the Administrative Agent. Subject to the foregoing, the conditions precedent to each Incremental Facility shall be solely those agreed to by the Lenders providing such Incremental Facility, as applicable, and the Borrower; provided that, subject to Section 1.3(a), no Event of Default has occurred and is continuing. Notwithstanding the foregoing or anything herein to the contrary, (1) any conditions, covenants and events of default (other than with respect to interest rate, fees, premiums, optional prepayment premiums and optional redemption provisions or as otherwise not prohibited herein, which may be determined by the Borrower and the relevant Lenders without restriction) of any Incremental Term Facility, shall be (as determined in good faith by the Borrower) (without any determination by any other Person and no consent of any existing Lender required) (A) substantially identical to or not materially more favorable to the investors or lenders providing such Indebtedness or materially more restrictive to the then-existing Term Lenders, in each case, than the covenants and events of default of the Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness (taken as a whole), (B) reasonably acceptable (taken as a whole) to the Administrative Agent and not materially adverse to the Lenders under the Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness (taken as a whole), (C) applicable only to periods after the stated maturity date of the Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, (D) be terms that would be favorable to (or for the benefit of) the then-existing Term Lenders (including the addition of any financial maintenance covenant), (E) added for the benefit of the Lenders holding the Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness or (F) otherwise customary for similar indebtedness or reflect market terms at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, and (2) any conditions, covenants and events of default (other than with respect to interest rate, fees, premiums, optional prepayment premiums and optional redemption provisions or as otherwise not prohibited herein, which may be determined by the Borrower and the relevant Lenders without restriction) of any Incremental Revolving Facility shall be on substantially the same terms as those applicable to any revolving credit facility existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness or otherwise reasonably acceptable to the Administrative Agent (it being understood and agreed that any terms that are not substantially the same as those applicable to any revolving credit facility existing at the time of Incurrence, but which are applicable only to periods after the stated maturity date of any revolving credit facility existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness shall be deemed acceptable to the Administrative Agent). To the extent the Borrower establishes any Incremental Revolving Facility structured as a new or separate Tranche of revolving commitments, then the Administrative Agent and the Borrower shall be permitted to amend this Agreement to require borrowings, repayments, participations and commitment reductions on a pro rata basis among Tranches of revolving commitments (except for (x) payments of interest and fees at different rates on the revolving commitments (and related outstandings), (y) repayments required upon the stated maturity date of any revolving loan, and (z) repayments made in connection with a permanent repayment and termination of the revolving loans or revolving commitments of revolving loans after the effective date of such Incremental Revolving Facility). If the Incremental Arranger is not the Administrative Agent, the actions authorized to be taken by the Incremental Arranger herein shall be done in consultation with the Administrative Agent and, with respect to the preparation of any documentation necessary or appropriate to carry out the provisions of this Section 4.17 (including amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents), any comments to such documentation reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent shall be reflected therein. Any Incremental Amendment may, without the consent of any other Loan Party, the Administrative Agent or Lender, effect such amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents as may be necessary or appropriate, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, to effect the provisions of this Section 4.17. For the avoidance of doubt, at the option of the Borrower, the Borrower may, in consultation with the Administrative Agent, but shall not be required to, increase the Applicable Margin, increase or add, amortization payments or increases or add call protection, in each case, relating to the Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness to achieve fungibility with such Term Loans.

 
98 (e) Specific Terms for Incremental Revolving Facilities. On the Incremental Effective Date with respect to an increase to an existing revolving Tranche, (x) each revolving credit lender immediately prior to such increase will automatically and without further act be deemed to have assigned to each Lender providing a portion of the increase to the revolving credit commitments (each, a “Revolving Commitment Increase Lender”), and each such Revolving Commitment Increase Lender will automatically and without further act be deemed to have assumed, a portion of such revolving credit lender’s participations hereunder in outstanding letter of credit obligations such that, after giving effect to each such deemed assignment and assumption of participations, the percentage of the aggregate outstanding participations hereunder in letter of credit obligations will equal the pro rata share of the aggregate revolving credit commitments of all revolving credit lenders represented by such revolving credit lender’s revolving credit commitment and (y) if, on the date of such increase, there are any revolving credit loans outstanding, such revolving credit loans shall on or prior to the Incremental Effective Date be prepaid from the proceeds of revolving credit loans made hereunder (reflecting such increase in revolving credit commitments), which prepayment shall be accompanied by accrued interest on the revolving credit loans being prepaid, unless waived by the applicable revolving credit lenders. The Administrative Agent and the Lenders hereby agree that the minimum borrowing, pro rata borrowing and pro rata payment requirements contained elsewhere in this Agreement shall not apply to the transactions effected pursuant to the immediately preceding sentence. (f) Other Terms of Certain Incremental Facilities. (i) With respect to any Incremental Facility (x) in the case of any Incremental Term Facility structured as a new or separate Tranche of Term Loans or Term Commitments or (y) in the case of any Incremental Revolving Facility structured as a new or separate Tranche of revolving commitments, then, as applicable, (A) shall not be Guaranteed by any Restricted Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party or Restricted Subsidiary that does not become a Loan Party in accordance with the applicable Sections of the Guarantee Agreement and the Security Agreement, as applicable, (B) if secured by a Lien on all or any portion of the Collateral, shall not be secured by a Lien any assets of any Loan Party other than assets that constitute Collateral, and (C) at the option of the Borrower, shall be secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a junior basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness or unsecured; provided that, (1) any Incremental Revolving Facility and Incremental Term Facility may be payment subordinated or be structured as “last-out” in the payment waterfall in a manner reasonably satisfactory to the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, and (2) if such Incremental Facility is incurred under the Effective Extension Incremental Facility, (x) such Incremental Facility may be secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness only to the extent such Incremental Facility effectively extends the maturity date of Indebtedness secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Lien on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans, and (y) such Incremental Facility may be secured by a Lien on the Collateral only to the extent such Incremental Facility effectively extends the maturity date of extended Indebtedness secured by a Lien on the Collateral,

 
99 (ii) Any Incremental Term Facility structured as an increase to any Tranche of Term Loans or Term Commitments or any Incremental Revolving Facility structured as an increase to any Tranche of revolving commitments, as applicable, shall, for purposes of mandatory prepayments, be treated no more favorably than such applicable Tranche (it being understood and agreed that any mandatory prepayments resulting from refinancings of any facility in particular may only be applied to such facility), (iii) Any Incremental Term Facility structured as a new or separate Tranche of Term Loans or Term Commitments that is secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness shall share ratably (or on a lesser basis) with respect to any mandatory prepayments of the Initial Term Loans (other than mandatory prepayments resulting from a refinancing of any Facility, which may be applied exclusively to the Facility being refinanced), and (iv) solely with respect to any broadly syndicated floating rate term loans denominated in Dollars that are incurred on or prior to the date that is twelve (12) months after the Closing Date under an Incremental Term Facility that is (x) pari passu in right of payment to the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness and (y) secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, the All-in Yield payable by the Borrower in respect of such Incremental Term Facility shall not be more than 75 basis points higher than the All-in Yield payable by the Borrower in respect of the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness unless the interest rate margin applicable to the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness is increased by an amount necessary so that the difference between the All-in Yield payable by the Borrower in respect of such Incremental Term Facility and the All-in Yield payable by the Borrower in respect of the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness is no greater than 75 basis points (provided that, if Term SOFR Rate in respect of such Incremental Term Facility includes a floor that is greater than the floor then applicable to the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, such increased amount shall be equated to interest rate margin for purposes of the interest rate margin of such Incremental Term Facility but only to the extent that an increase in the interest rate floor of the Initial Term Loans existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness would cause an increase in the interest rate margin then in effect with respect to such interest rate) (this clause (iv), the “MFN Provision”); provided that this clause (iv) shall not apply to (I) any Incremental Term Facility that has a final maturity at least twelve (12) months later than the Latest Maturity Date of any Term Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness or (II) Incremental Term Facilities in an aggregate amount not exceeding the greater of (x) $1,328,000,000 and (y) 50.0% of TTM EBITDA at the time of Incurrence. (g) Miscellaneous. This Section 4.17 shall supersede any provisions in Section 4.8 or Section 11.1 to the contrary. For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in this Section 4.17 shall be deemed to restrict the Borrower from including in any Incremental Amendment additional amendments, modifications and waivers that are conditional upon obtaining the consent of the requisite threshold of Lenders as required for such amendment, modification or waiver under Section 11.1 after giving effect to the Incurrence of the Incremental Facility in accordance with this Section 4.17. 4.18 Extension Amendments. (a) Extension of Commitments and Loans. The Borrower may at any time and from time to time request that all or a portion, including one or more Tranches, of any Commitments or Loans (including

 
100 any Extended Loans), each existing at the time of such request (each, an “Existing Tranche” and the Loans of such Tranche, the “Existing Loans”) be converted or refinanced to extend the termination date thereof and the scheduled maturity date(s) of any payment of principal with respect to all or a portion of any principal amount of any Existing Tranche (any such Existing Tranche which has been so extended, “Extended Tranche” and the Loans of such Tranche, the “Extended Loans”) and to provide for other terms consistent with this Section 4.18. In order to establish any Extended Tranche, the Borrower shall provide a notice to the Administrative Agent and the Person appointed by the Borrower to arrange an Extended Tranche (such Person (who may be (i) the Administrative Agent, if it so agrees, or (ii) any other Person appointed by the Borrower), the “Extended Tranche Arranger”) (who shall provide a copy of such notice to each of the Lenders of the applicable Existing Tranche) (an “Extension Request”) setting forth the proposed terms of the Extended Tranche to be established, which terms (other than provided in Section 4.18(c) below) shall be identical to those applicable to the Existing Tranche from which they are to be extended (the “Specified Existing Tranche”) except (x) all or any of the final maturity dates of such Extended Tranches may be delayed to later dates than the final maturity dates of the Specified Existing Tranche, (y) (A) the interest margins with respect to the Extended Tranche may be higher or lower than the interest margins for the Specified Existing Tranche or (B) additional fees, original issue discount or premiums may be payable to the Lenders providing such Extended Tranche in addition to or in lieu of any increased margins contemplated by the preceding clause (A) and (z) the commitment fee, if any, with respect to the Extended Tranche may be higher or lower than the commitment fee, if any, for the Specified Existing Tranche, in each case to the extent provided in the applicable Extension Amendment; provided that (1) such Extended Tranche shall be, in the case of any Extended Tranche relating to Term Loans, (x) in a minimum amount of the lesser of $10,000,000 (or such smaller amount as the Extended Tranche Arranger may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent amount to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any extension that may be requested under this Section 4.18 and (y) to the extent in excess of the minimum amount set forth in clause (x), in integrals in excess thereof equal to the lesser of $1,000,000 (or such smaller amount as the Extended Tranche Arranger may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any extension that may be requested under this Section 4.18, (2) (x) such Extended Tranche shall not be Guaranteed by any Restricted Subsidiary that is not a Loan Party or does not become a Loan Party in accordance with the applicable Sections of the Guarantee Agreement and the Security Agreement, as applicable, (y) if secured by a Lien on all or any portion of the Collateral, such Extended Tranche shall not be secured by a Lien on any assets of any Loan Party other than assets that constitute Collateral, and (z) at the option of the Borrower, such Extended Tranche shall be secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a pari passu basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Specified Existing Tranche or secured by a Lien on the Collateral on a junior basis to the Liens on the Collateral securing the Specified Existing Tranche or unsecured, but in no case senior to the Lien on the Collateral securing the applicable Specified Existing Tranche; provided that, if such Extended Tranche is secured by a Lien on all or any portion of the Collateral, such Extended Tranche shall be subject to Intercreditor Agreements; provided, further, that the foregoing shall not restrict such Extended Tranche from being treated as a “last-out” tranche with the consent of the parties thereto to such Extension Amendment, (3) the repayment (other than in connection with a permanent repayment and, if applicable, termination of commitments), the mandatory prepayment and the commitment reduction of any of Loans or commitments under the Extended Tranches shall be made on a pro rata basis with all other outstanding Loans or commitments (including all Extended Tranches) respectively; provided that, Extended Loans may, if the Borrower and the Extending Lenders making such Extended Loans so agree, participate on a less than pro rata basis in any voluntary or mandatory repayment or prepayment or commitment reductions hereunder, (4) the final maturity of any Extended Tranche shall not be earlier than, and if such Extended Tranche is a term facility, shall not have a Weighted Average Life to Maturity shorter than the applicable Specified Existing Tranche; provided that, in each case, (x) Extendable Loans/Interim Debt and (y) amounts not in excess of the maximum aggregate principal amount then permitted to be incurred in reliance on the Inside Maturity Basket, in each case, may (1) have a maturity date earlier than the Latest Maturity Date for the Specified Existing Tranche outstanding

 
101 at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness and (2) have a Weighted Average Life to Maturity shorter than the remaining Weighted Average Life to Maturity of the Specified Existing Tranche outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, and (5) assignments and participations of Extended Tranches shall be governed by the same assignment and participation provisions, or at the Borrower’s election, more restrictive assignment and participation provisions, applicable to Loans and Commitments hereunder as set forth in Section 11.6. No Lender shall have any obligation to agree to have any of its Existing Loans or, if applicable, commitments of any Existing Tranche converted into an Extended Tranche pursuant to any Extension Request. Any Extended Tranche shall constitute a separate Tranche of Loans (and, if applicable, commitments) from the Specified Existing Tranches and from any other Existing Tranches (together with any other Extended Tranches so established on such date). (b) Extending Lenders. The Borrower shall provide the applicable Extension Request at least five (5) Business Days (or such shorter period of time as consented to by the Extended Tranche Arranger) prior to the date on which Lenders under the applicable Existing Tranche or Existing Tranches are requested to respond. Any Lender (an “Extending Lender”) wishing to have all or a portion of its Specified Existing Tranche converted into an Extended Tranche shall notify the Extended Tranche Arranger (an “Extension Election”) on or prior to the date specified in such Extension Request of the amount of its Specified Existing Tranche that it has elected to convert or refinance into an Extended Tranche. In the event that the aggregate amount of the Specified Existing Tranche subject to Extension Elections exceeds the amount of Extended Tranches requested pursuant to the Extension Request, the Specified Existing Tranches subject to Extension Elections shall be converted to Extended Tranches on a pro rata basis among the Lenders extended the option to participate in such Extension Election based on the amount of Specified Existing Tranches included in each such Extension Election. In connection with this Section 4.18, the Borrower and Extended Tranche Arranger shall agree to such procedures regarding timing, rounding, lender revocation and other administrative adjustments to ensure reasonable administrative management of the credit facilities hereunder after such Extension Election, in each case, acting reasonably to accomplish the purposes of this Section 4.18. The Borrower may amend, revoke or replace an Extension Request pursuant to procedures reasonably acceptable to the Extended Tranche Arranger at any time prior to the date on which Lenders under the applicable Existing Tranche are requested to respond to the Extension Request or the Borrower may at its election specify as a condition to consummating any such extension hereunder that a minimum amount (to be determined and specified in the relevant Extension Request in the Borrower’s sole discretion and may be waived by the Borrower) of Existing Loans of any or all applicable Tranches be extended. (c) Extension Amendment; Effectiveness. Extended Tranches shall be established pursuant to an amendment (an “Extension Amendment”) to this Agreement and any other Loan Document (which may include amendments to provisions related to maturity, interest margins, fees or prepayments referenced in Section 4.18(a) and which, in each case, except to the extent expressly contemplated by the last sentence of this Section 4.18(c)) (solely with the execution of the Borrower and the Lenders party to an Extension Amendment (or the Extended Tranche Arranger, for and on behalf of the Lenders party to an Extension Amendment) (and, for the avoidance of doubt, the Administrative Agent and Lenders are hereby deemed to authorize and approve of each Extension Amendment entered into in accordance with this Section 4.18)) in order to establish the Extended Tranche and to reflect any technical, administrative or other changes necessary, appropriate or otherwise not prohibited (including such changes in described in this clause (c) below) to give effect to such Extended Tranche in accordance with its terms as set forth herein pursuant to the Extension Amendment. Any amendment may, without the consent of any other Loan Party, the Administrative Agent or Lender, effect such amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents as may be necessary or appropriate, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, to effect the provisions of this Section 4.18. Notwithstanding the foregoing or anything herein to the contrary, any conditions, covenants and events of default (other than with respect to interest rate, fees, premiums, optional prepayment premiums and optional redemption provisions or as otherwise not prohibited herein, which may be determined by the Borrower and the relevant Lenders without restriction)

existing at the time of Incurrence, but which are applicable only to periods after the stated maturity date of the revolving credit facility existing at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness shall be deemed acceptable to the Administrative Agent). To the extent the Borrower establishes any Extended Tranche of revolving commitments, then the Administrative Agent and the Borrower shall be permitted to amend this Agreement to require borrowings, repayments, participations and commitment reductions on a pro rata basis among Tranches of revolving commitments (except for (x) payments of interest and fees at different rates on the revolving commitments (and related outstandings), (y) repayments required upon the stated maturity date of any revolving loan, and (z) repayments made in connection with a permanent repayment and termination of the revolving loans or revolving commitments of revolving loans after the effective date of such Extended Tranche). If the Extended Tranche Arranger is not the Administrative Agent, the actions authorized to be taken by the Extended Tranche Arranger herein shall be done in consultation with the Administrative Agent and, with respect to the preparation of any documentation necessary or appropriate to carry out the provisions of this Section 4.18 (including amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents), any comments to such documentation reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent shall be reflected therein. For the avoidance of doubt, the MFN Provision shall not apply with respect to any Extended Tranche. (d) Extension Date. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained herein, on any date on which any Existing Tranche is converted to extend the related scheduled maturity date(s) in accordance with Section 4.18(a) (an “Extension Date”), in the case of the Specified Existing Tranche of each Extending Lender, the aggregate principal amount of such Specified Existing Tranche shall be deemed reduced by an amount equal to the aggregate principal amount of Extended Tranche so converted by such Lender on such date, and such Extended Tranches shall be established as a separate Tranche from the Specified Existing Tranche and from any other Existing Tranches (together with any other Extended Tranches so established on such date). (e) Non-Extending Lenders. If, in connection with any proposed Extension Amendment, any Lender declines to consent to the applicable extension on the terms and by the deadline set forth in the applicable Extension Request (each such Lender, a “Non-Extending Lender”) then the Borrower may, on notice to the Extended Tranche Arranger and the Non-Extending Lender, (A) replace such Non-Extending Lender by causing such Lender to (and such Lender shall be obligated to) assign pursuant to Section 11.6 (with the assignment fee and any other costs and expenses to be paid by the Borrower in such instance) all

 
103 of its rights and obligations under this Agreement to one or more assignees; provided that neither the Administrative Agent nor any Lender shall have any obligation to the Borrower to obtain a replacement Lender; provided, further, that the applicable assignee shall have agreed to provide Loans or a Commitment on the terms set forth in such Extension Amendment; provided, further, that all Obligations (other than Excluded Obligations) of the Borrower owing to the Non-Extending Lender relating to the Loans and participations so assigned shall be paid in full at par (or such lesser amount as consented to by the applicable Non-Extending Lender) by the assignee Lender to such Non-Extending Lender concurrently with such Assignment and Assumption or (B) prepay the Loans and, at the Borrower’s option, if applicable, terminate the Commitments of such Non-Extending Lender, in whole or in part, without premium or penalty. In connection with any such replacement under this Section 4.18, if the Non-Extending Lender does not execute and deliver to the Extended Tranche Arranger a duly completed Assignment and Assumption or any other documentation necessary to reflect such replacement by the later of (a) the date on which the replacement Lender executes and delivers such Assignment and Assumption or such other documentation and (b) the date as of which all Obligations (other than the Excluded Obligations) of the Borrower owing to the Non-Extending Lender relating to the Loans and participations so assigned shall be paid in full in cash by the assignee Lender to such Non-Extending Lender, then such Non-Extending Lender shall be deemed to have executed and delivered such Assignment and Assumption or such other documentation as of such date without any action on the part of such Non-Extending Lender and the Assignment and Assumption executed by the replacement Lender shall be effective for the purposes of this Section 4.18 or the Borrower may otherwise at such time, pay such Obligations in cash (which, for the avoidance of doubt, may be on a non- pro rata basis). Following any Extension Date, with the written consent of the Borrower, any Non-Extending Lender may elect to have all or a portion of its Existing Loans deemed to be an Extended Loan under the applicable Extended Tranche on any date (each date, a “Designation Date”) prior to the maturity date of such Extended Tranche; provided that such Lender shall have provided written notice to the Borrower and the Extended Tranche Arranger at least ten (10) Business Days prior to such Designation Date (or such shorter period as the Extended Tranche Arranger may agree in its reasonable discretion); provided, further, that no greater amount shall be paid by or on behalf of the Borrower or any of its Affiliates to any such Non-Extending Lender as consideration for its extension into such Extended Tranche than was paid to any Extending Lender as consideration for its extension hereunder into such Extended Tranche. Following a Designation Date, the Existing Loans held by such Lender so elected to be extended will be deemed to be Extended Loans of the applicable Extended Tranche, and any Existing Loans held by such Lender not elected to be extended, if any, shall continue to be “Existing Loans” of the applicable Tranche. (f) Miscellaneous. This Section 4.18 shall supersede any provisions in Section 4.8 or Section 11.1 to the contrary. For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in this Section 4.18 shall be deemed to restrict the Borrower from including in any Extension Amendment additional amendments, modifications and waivers that are conditional upon obtaining the consent of the requisite threshold of Lenders as required for such amendment, modification or waiver under Section 11.1 after giving effect to the Incurrence of the Extended Tranche in accordance with this Section 4.18. (g) No Deemed Payment or Prepayment. No amendment, conversion or exchange of Loans pursuant to any Extension Amendment in accordance with Section 4.18 shall constitute a voluntary or mandatory payment or prepayment for purposes of this Agreement. 4.19 Refinancing Facilities. Commitments hereunder as set forth in Section 11.6. (b) This Agreement and the other Loan Documents may be amended pursuant to a Refinancing Amendment (which may include amendments to provisions referenced in Section 4.19(a) and which, in each case, except to the extent expressly contemplated by the last sentence of this Section 4.19(b)) (solely with the execution of the Borrower and the Lenders party to such Refinancing Amendment (or the Refinancing Arranger, for and on behalf of the Lenders party to such Refinancing Amendment)) (and, for the avoidance of doubt, the Administrative Agent and Lenders are hereby deemed to authorize and approve of each Refinancing Amendment entered into in accordance with this Section 4.19) in order to establish the Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness and to reflect any technical, administrative or other changes necessary, appropriate or otherwise not prohibited (including such changes in described in the definition of

 
105 Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness or any changes described in this Section 4.19(b) below or Section 4.19(c)) to give effect to such Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness in accordance with its terms as set forth herein pursuant to the Refinancing Amendment. Any Refinancing Amendment may, without the consent of any other Loan Party, the Administrative Agent or Lender, effect such amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents as may be necessary or appropriate, in the reasonable opinion of the Administrative Agent and the Borrower, to effect the provisions of this Section 4.19. Notwithstanding the foregoing or anything herein to the contrary, (1) any conditions, covenants and events of default (other than with respect to interest rate, fees, premiums, optional prepayment premiums and optional redemption provisions or as otherwise not prohibited herein, which may be determined by the Borrower and the relevant Lenders without restriction) of any Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness, shall be (as determined in good faith by the Borrower) (without any determination by any other Person and no consent of any existing Lender required) (A) not materially more favorable to the investors or lenders providing such Indebtedness or materially more restrictive to the then-existing Lenders, in each case, than the covenants and events of default of the Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness (taken as a whole), (B) reasonably acceptable (taken as a whole) to the Administrative Agent and not materially adverse to the Lenders under the Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness (taken as a whole), (C) applicable only to periods after the stated maturity date of the Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Indebtedness, (D) be terms that would be favorable to (or for the benefit of) the then-existing Lenders (including the addition of any financial maintenance covenant), (E) added for the benefit of the Lenders holding the Loans outstanding at the time of Incurrence of such Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness or (F) otherwise customary for similar indebtedness or reflect market terms at the time of Incurrence of such Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness. To the extent the Borrower establishes any Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness of revolving commitments, then the Administrative Agent and the Borrower shall be permitted to amend this Agreement to require borrowings, repayments, participations and commitment reductions on a pro rata basis among Tranches of revolving commitments (except for (x) payments of interest and fees at different rates on the revolving commitments (and related outstandings), (y) repayments required upon the stated maturity date of any revolving loan, and (z) repayments made in connection with a permanent repayment and termination of the revolving loans or revolving commitments of revolving loans after the effective date of such Extended Tranche). If the Refinancing Arranger is not the Administrative Agent, the actions authorized to be taken by the Refinancing Arranger herein shall be done in consultation with the Administrative Agent and, with respect to the preparation of any documentation necessary or appropriate to carry out the provisions of this Section 4.19 (including amendments to this Agreement and the other Loan Documents), any comments to such documentation reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent shall be reflected therein. (c) Miscellaneous. This Section 4.19 shall supersede any provisions in Section 4.8 or Section 11.1 to the contrary. For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in this Section 4.19 shall be deemed to restrict the Borrower from including in any Refinancing Amendment additional amendments, modifications and waivers that are conditional upon obtaining the consent of the requisite threshold of Lenders as required for such amendment, modification or waiver under Section 11.1 after giving effect to the Incurrence of the Credit Agreement Refinancing Indebtedness in accordance with this Section 4.19. 4.20 Permitted Debt Exchanges. (a) General Terms and Mechanics. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in this Agreement, pursuant to one or more offers (each, a “Permitted Debt Exchange Offer”) made from time to time by the Borrower, the Borrower may from time to time following the Closing Date consummate one or more exchanges of Term Loans for Permitted Debt Exchange Notes (each such exchange a “Permitted Debt Exchange”) with any Lender (other than any Lender that, if requested by the Borrower, is unable to certify that it is either a “qualified institutional buyer” (as defined in Rule 144A under the Securities Act) or an institutional “accredited investor” (as defined in Rule 501 under the Securities Act)), so long as the

 
106 following conditions are satisfied: (i) the aggregate principal amount (calculated on the face amount thereof) of Term Loans exchanged shall equal no more than the aggregate principal amount (calculated on the face amount thereof) of Permitted Debt Exchange Notes issued in exchange for such Term Loans; provided that the aggregate principal amount of the Permitted Debt Exchange Notes may include accrued interest and premium (if any) under the Term Loans exchanged and underwriting discounts, fees, commissions and expenses in connection with the issuance of such Permitted Debt Exchange Notes, (ii) the aggregate principal amount (calculated on the face amount thereof) of all Term Loans exchanged by the Borrower pursuant to any Permitted Debt Exchange shall automatically be cancelled and retired by the Borrower on the date of the settlement thereof (and, if requested by the Administrative Agent, any applicable exchanging Lender shall execute and deliver to the Administrative Agent an Assignment and Assumption, or such other form as may be reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent, in respect thereof pursuant to which the respective Lender assigns its interest in the Term Loans being exchanged pursuant to the Permitted Debt Exchange to the Borrower for immediate cancellation), (iii) if the aggregate principal amount of all Term Loans (calculated on the face amount thereof) tendered by Lenders in respect of the relevant Permitted Debt Exchange Offer (with no Lender being permitted to tender a principal amount of Term Loans which exceeds the principal amount thereof actually held by it) shall exceed the maximum aggregate principal amount of such Term Loans offered to be exchanged by the Borrower pursuant to such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer, then the Borrower shall exchange Term Loans subject to such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer tendered by such Lenders ratably up to such maximum amount based on the respective principal amounts so tendered, (iv) such Indebtedness shall otherwise satisfy the applicable conditions and requirements set forth under Section 4.17(d)(i)(D), clauses (1) of the final paragraph of (d), (f)(i), and (f)(iii) as if such Indebtedness were an Incremental Term Facility, (v) all documentation in respect of such Permitted Debt Exchange shall be consistent with the foregoing, and all written communications generally directed to the Lenders in connection therewith shall be in form and substance consistent with the foregoing and made in consultation with the Borrower and the Person appointed by the Borrower to arrange a Permitted Debt Exchange (such Person (who may be (1) the Administrative Agent, if it so agrees, or (2) any other Person appointed by the Borrower), the “Exchange Agent”) and (vi) any applicable Permitted Debt Exchange Minimum Tender Condition shall be satisfied. (b) Minimum Tender Condition. With respect to all Permitted Debt Exchanges effected by the Borrower pursuant to this Section 4.20, (i) such Permitted Debt Exchanges (and the cancellation of the exchanged Term Loans in connection therewith) shall not constitute voluntary or mandatory payments or prepayments for purposes of Section 4.1 or Section 4.2, and (ii) such Permitted Debt Exchange Offer shall be (x) in a minimum amount of the lesser of $10,000,000 (or such smaller amount as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any increase that may be requested under this Section 4.20 and (y) to the extent in excess of the minimum amount set forth in clause (x), in integrals in excess thereof equal to the lesser of $1,000,000 (or such smaller amount as the Administrative Agent may agree in its sole discretion) (or the Dollar Equivalent to the extent denominated in an Alternative Currency) and the entire amount of any increase that may be requested under this Section 4.20; provided that subject to the foregoing clause (ii) the Borrower may at its election specify as a condition (a “Permitted Debt Exchange Minimum Tender Condition”) to consummating any such Permitted Debt Exchange that a minimum amount (to be determined and specified in the relevant Permitted Debt Exchange Offer in the Borrower’s discretion) of Term Loans of any or all applicable classes be tendered. (c) Procedures. In connection with each Permitted Debt Exchange, the Borrower and the Exchange Agent shall mutually agree to such procedures as may be necessary or advisable to accomplish the purposes of this Section 4.20(c) and without conflict with Section 4.20(d); provided that the terms of any Permitted Debt Exchange Offer shall provide that the date by which the relevant Lenders are required to indicate their election to participate in such Permitted Debt Exchange shall be not less than a reasonable

 
107 period (in the discretion of the Borrower and the Exchange Agent) of time following the date on which the Permitted Debt Exchange Offer is made. (d) Compliance with Laws. The Borrower shall be responsible for compliance with, and hereby agrees to comply with, all applicable securities Laws in connection with each Permitted Debt Exchange, it being understood and agreed that (x) none of the Exchange Agent, the Administrative Agent nor any Lender assumes any responsibility in connection with the Borrower’s compliance with such laws in connection with any Permitted Debt Exchange (other than the Borrower’s reliance on any certificate delivered pursuant to Section 4.20(a) for which such Lender shall bear sole responsibility) and (y) each Lender shall be solely responsible for its compliance with any applicable “insider trading” laws to which such Lender may be subject under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or other applicable securities Laws. (e) Agent Consultation. If the Exchange Agent is not the Administrative Agent, the actions authorized to be taken by the Exchange Agent herein shall be done in consultation with the Administrative Agent and, with respect to the preparation of any documentation necessary or appropriate to carry out the provisions of this Section 4.20(a), any comments to such documentation reasonably requested by the Administrative Agent shall be reflected therein. SECTION 5. REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES To induce the Administrative Agent and the Lenders to enter into this Agreement and to make the Loans, the Borrower hereby represents and warrants to the Administrative Agent and each Lender (it being understood that the following representations and warranties shall be deemed made with respect to any Foreign Subsidiary only to the extent relevant under applicable law) that, on and as of the Closing Date (and, to the extent required under the terms of this Agreement, on and as of the date of a borrowing hereunder): 5.1 Financial Condition; No Material Adverse Effect. (a) The (i) audited consolidated balance sheets and the related consolidated statements of income and of cash flows of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024 and for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 and (ii) the unaudited consolidated balance sheet of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as of March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026 and the related consolidated statements of income or operations, changes in stockholders’ equity and cash flows as of and for the three- month period ended March 31, 2026 and June 30, 2026 and for the comparable period of the preceding fiscal year certified by a Responsible Officer of the Borrower, in each case, present fairly in all material respects the consolidated financial condition of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries, as of such dates and their consolidated results of operations and consolidated cash flows for the periods to which they relate (subject to normal year end audit adjustments and the absence of footnotes). All such financial statements, including the related schedules and notes (if any) thereto, have been prepared in accordance with GAAP applied consistently throughout the periods involved (except as disclosed therein). (b) Since December 31, 2025, there has not been any development or event that has had or would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.2 Corporate Existence; Compliance with Law. Each of the Borrower and its Material Subsidiaries (a) is duly incorporated, organized or formed, validly existing and in good standing under the laws of the jurisdiction of its incorporation, organization or formation, as applicable, to the extent such concept exists in such jurisdiction, (b) has the requisite organizational power and authority, to own and operate its property, to lease the property it operates as lessee and to conduct the business in which it is

 
108 currently engaged, (c) is duly qualified as a foreign corporation or other organization and in good standing (where relevant) under the laws of each jurisdiction where its ownership, lease or operation of property or the conduct of its business requires such qualification, and (d) is in compliance with all Requirements of Law and Organizational Documents; except in each case, referred to in clauses (a) (other than with respect to the Borrower), (b), (c) or (d) to the extent that the failure to comply therewith would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.3 Power; Authorization; Enforceable Obligations. (a) Each Loan Party has the requisite organizational power and authority to execute, deliver and perform its obligations under the Loan Documents to which it is a party and, in the case of the Borrower, to obtain extensions of credit under this Agreement. (b) Each Loan Party has taken all necessary organizational action to authorize the execution, delivery and performance of the Loan Documents to which it is a party and, in the case of the Borrower, to authorize the borrowings under this Agreement. (c) No consent or authorization of, filing with, notice to or other act by or in respect of, any Governmental Authority is required in connection with the Transactions, or the execution, delivery, performance, validity or enforceability of the Loan Documents except for (i) filings and registrations necessary to perfect the Liens on the Collateral granted by the Loan Parties, (ii) the consents, authorizations, actions, notices and filings which have been duly obtained, taken, given or made and are in full force and effect (except to the extent not required to be obtained, taken, given or made or be in full force and effect pursuant to any Loan Document), (iii) those consents, authorizations or other actions, notices or filings set out in the Security Documents, and (iv) those approvals, consents, exemptions, authorizations or other actions, notices or filings, the failure of which to obtain or make would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. (d) This Agreement constitutes, and each other Loan Document upon execution will constitute, in each case, a legal, valid and binding obligation of each Loan Party party thereto, enforceable against such Loan Party in accordance with its terms, except as such enforceability may be limited by (i) Debtor Relief Laws and general principles of equity (whether in a court of law or equity), (ii) an implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, (iii) the need for filings, notices and registrations necessary to create or perfect the Liens on the Collateral granted by any Loan Party in favor of the Secured Parties, or (iv) the effect of foreign laws, rules and regulations as they relate to the granting of security interests in assets of, and pledges of Capital Stock issued by Foreign Subsidiaries or Indebtedness owed by Foreign Subsidiaries (the foregoing clauses (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv), the “Enforcement Qualifications”). 5.4 No Legal Bar. The execution, delivery and performance of the Loan Documents and the borrowings hereunder by the applicable Loan Parties do not violate, in any material respect, any Requirement of Law, Organizational Documents or any material Contractual Obligation of any Loan Party in respect of Indebtedness for borrowed money with an outstanding principal balance in excess of the Threshold Amount or result in or require the creation or imposition of any Lien on any property or revenues of any Loan Party in any material respect pursuant to any Requirement of Law, Organizational Documents or material Contractual Obligation (other than the Liens created by the Security Documents) in respect of Indebtedness for borrowed money with an outstanding principal balance in excess of the Threshold Amount, except to the extent that such violation, conflict, breach or contravention would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.5 Litigation. No litigation, investigation or proceeding of or before any arbitrator or Governmental Authority is pending or, to the knowledge of the Borrower, threatened in writing by or against the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary or against any of their respective Properties or revenues that have a reasonable likelihood of adverse determination and such determination would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.6 No Default. No Default or Event of Default has occurred and is continuing.

Each of the Borrower and its Material Subsidiaries owns, or is licensed to use, all Intellectual Property used in the conduct of its business as currently conducted, except to the extent such failure to own or possess the right to use would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. Except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect: (a) there are no strikes or other labor disputes against the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary pending or, to the knowledge of the Borrower, threatened in writing by their respective employees; and (b) to the knowledge of the Borrower, hours worked by and payment made to employees of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary have not been in violation of the Fair Labor Standards Act or any other similar applicable Requirement of Law regarding minimum wages or overtime payments. 5.12 ERISA. Neither a Reportable Event nor a failure to satisfy the minimum funding standard (within the meaning of Sections 412 and 430 of the Code or Sections 302 and 303 of ERISA) has occurred during the five-year period prior to the date on which this representation is made or deemed made with respect to any Single Employer Plan, whether or not waived, which resulted in a Material Adverse Effect, and except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect, each Single Employer Plan has complied in all material respects with the applicable provisions of ERISA and the Code. No termination of a Single Employer Plan has occurred, and no Lien in favor of the PBGC or a Plan has arisen, during such five-year period, in each case, except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. The present value of all accrued benefits under each Single Employer Plan (based on those assumptions used to fund such Plans) did not, as of the last annual valuation date prior to the date on which this representation is made or deemed made, exceed the value of the assets of such Plan allocable to such accrued benefits by an amount that would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. Neither the Borrower, any Restricted Subsidiary, nor Commonly Controlled Entity has had a complete or partial withdrawal from any Multiemployer Plan that would reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. No such Multiemployer Plan is Insolvent, or was determined to or expected to be in

 
110 “critical” or “endangered” status under Section 432 of the Code or Section 305 of ERISA, and no Single Employer Plan was determined to or expected to be in “at risk” status as defined in Section 430 of the Code or Section 303 of ERISA, and no Borrower, any Restricted Subsidiary or Commonly Controlled Entity would become subject to any material liability under ERISA if Borrower, any Restricted Subsidiary or Commonly Controlled Entity were to withdraw completely from all Multiemployer Plans as of the valuation date most closely preceding the date on which this representation is made or deemed made, except in each case of the foregoing as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. No Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary has any liability with respect to any employee benefit plan that is not subject to the laws of the United States or a political subdivision thereof that would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect. 5.13 Investment Company Act. No Loan Party is an “investment company”, or a company “controlled” by an “investment company”, in either case, as required to be registered as such, under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended. 5.14 Restricted Subsidiaries. As of the Closing Date, (a) Schedule 5.14 sets forth the name and jurisdiction of organization of each Restricted Subsidiary and, as to each such Restricted Subsidiary, the percentage of each class of Capital Stock owned by any Loan Party, (b) there are no outstanding subscriptions, options, warrants, calls, rights or other agreements or commitments of any nature relating to any Capital Stock of the Loan Party (other than the Borrower), except as created by the Loan Documents and (c) all of the outstanding Capital Stock in the Restricted Subsidiaries that are owned by a Loan Party have been validly issued, are fully paid and non-assessable (other than for those Restricted Subsidiaries that are limited liability companies and limited partnerships and to the extent such concepts are not applicable in the relevant jurisdiction). 5.15 Use of Proceeds. The proceeds of the Initial Term Loans made on the Closing Date shall be used for the Closing Date Use of Proceeds. 5.16 Environmental Matters. Except as would not reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect: (a) the facilities and properties currently owned, leased or operated by the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary (the “Properties”) do not contain contamination from any Materials of Environmental Concern in amounts or concentrations or under circumstances that would reasonably be expected to give rise to liability of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary under, any Environmental Law; (b) neither the Borrower nor any Restricted Subsidiary has received any outstanding written notice of violation, alleged violation, non-compliance or liability or potential liability, under Environmental Laws, including with regard to any of the Properties or the Borrower’s or any Restricted Subsidiary’s operation of any of the Properties or the business operated by the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary (the “Business”), nor does the Borrower have knowledge that any such notice is reasonably likely to be received or is being threatened; (c) the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries (i) conduct the Business in compliance with Environmental Law, (ii) hold all Environmental Permits (each of which is in full force and effect) required pursuant to Environmental Law for the conduct of the Business as currently conducted, and (iii) are in compliance with all such Environmental Permits; (d) Materials of Environmental Concern have not been transported or disposed of by or, to the extent permitted or arranged by the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary, on behalf of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary (including from the Properties) in violation of, or in a manner or to a location

 
111 that would reasonably be expected to give rise to liability of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary under, any Environmental Law, nor during the Borrower’s or any Restricted Subsidiary’s ownership or operation of the Properties or during the Borrower’s or any Restricted Subsidiary’s ownership or operation of any formerly owned, leased or operated facilities or properties (“Former Properties”), have Materials of Environmental Concern been generated, treated, stored or disposed of, exposed to any person, released or threatened to be released at, on or under any of the Properties or Former Properties or otherwise in connection with the Business in violation of Environmental Law, or in a manner that would give rise to liability of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary under, any Environmental Law; and (e) no judicial proceeding or governmental or administrative action is pending or, to the knowledge of the Borrower, threatened, under any Environmental Law against the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary (including with respect to the Properties or the Business or, any Former Properties), nor are there any consent decrees, consent orders, administrative orders or other binding orders, or other binding administrative or judicial requirements, in each case that impose outstanding liabilities or obligations on the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary under any Environmental Law (including with respect to the Properties or the Business or, any Former Properties). 5.17 Disclosure. The Projection Materials contained in the materials referenced above are based upon good faith estimates and assumptions believed by management of the Borrower to be reasonable at the time prepared and at the time such matters are made available to the Administrative Agent or the Lenders prior to the Closing Date, it being recognized by the Administrative Agent and the Lenders that such Projection Materials are not to be viewed as fact or guarantees of performance and that actual results during the period or periods covered by the Projection Materials may differ significantly from the projected results and such differences may be material. 5.18 Security Documents. (a) Filings; Possessory Collateral. AFFIRMATIVE COVENANTS From and after the Closing Date until the occurrence of the Termination Date, the Borrower hereby agrees that the Borrower shall, and shall (except in the case of the covenants set forth in Sections 7.1, 7.2, 7.12, and 7.13), cause each of its Restricted Subsidiaries to: 7.1 Financial Statements. (a) Annual and Quarterly Financial Statements. Furnish to the Administrative Agent on behalf of each Lender: (i) Within 150 days after the end of each fiscal year of the Borrower (in each case, which period for delivery may be extended by (A) automatically for up to a period of time such that the due date hereunder is not earlier than the date at which the Borrower (or its parent or indirect parent thereof) is required to publicly file its applicable 10-K with the SEC (or such equivalent document), (B) automatically for thirty (30) days if (1) a material acquisition, material investment or a material disposition (in each case, as reasonably determined by the Borrower in good faith) has been consummated during the last fiscal year or (2) a material accounting change (as reasonably determined by the Borrower in good faith) has been consummated during the last fiscal year or (C) up to thirty (30) days at the election of the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion), a copy of the audited consolidated balance sheet of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as at the end of such year and the related audited consolidated statements of income and of cash flows for such year, setting forth in each case in comparative form the figures for the previous year and accompanied by a report and opinion of an Independent Financial Advisor and shall be without any “going concern” qualification or any qualification as to the scope of such audit (other than a “going concern” qualification that is as a result of or otherwise relates to (I) upcoming or impending maturity of any Indebtedness, (II) any anticipated, prospective or actual inability to satisfy any financial covenant, (III) any accounting rule change (including changes in accounting principles or practices reflecting changes in GAAP), or (IV) activities, operations, conditions, financial results, assets or liabilities of any Person other than the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary); it being understood and agreed that the foregoing shall not prohibit any emphasis of the matter paragraph or footnote or any other disclosure or explanatory note; and (ii) Within 60 days after the end of each of the first three quarterly periods of each fiscal year of the Borrower (in each case, which period for delivery may be extended by (A) automatically for up to a period of time such that the due date hereunder is not earlier than the date at which the Borrower (or its parent or indirect parent thereof) is required to publicly file its applicable 10-Q with the SEC (or such equivalent document), (B) automatically for thirty (30) days if (1) a material acquisition, material investment or a material disposition (in each case, as reasonably determined by the Borrower in good faith) has been consummated during the last fiscal quarter or (2) a material accounting change (as reasonably determined by the Borrower in good faith) has been consummated during the last fiscal quarter or (C) up to thirty (30) days at the election of the Administrative Agent in its sole discretion), the unaudited consolidated balance sheet of the Borrower and its Subsidiaries as at the end of such quarter and the related unaudited consolidated statements of income and of cash flows for such quarter and the portion of the fiscal year through the end of such quarter, setting forth in each case in comparative form the figures for the previous year, certified by a Responsible Officer as being fairly stated in accordance with GAAP in all material respects (subject to normal year-end audit adjustments and the absence of footnotes);

 
116 provided that any change in GAAP (or relevant pronouncements) or in the application thereof shall not be required to be reflected in the financial statements delivered pursuant to this Section 7.1(a)(ii) until after such changes are reflected in the audited financial statements most recently delivered pursuant to Section 7.1(a)(i). (b) GAAP Compliant. All such financial statements shall be complete and correct in all material respects and shall be prepared in reasonable detail and in accordance, in all material respects, with GAAP applied consistently throughout the periods reflected therein and with prior periods (except as approved by such accountants or officer, as the case may be, and disclosed therein). (c) Alternative Reporting. Notwithstanding the foregoing, the obligations in Sections 7.1(a) may be satisfied with respect to financial information of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries by furnishing (I) the applicable financial statements of any direct or indirect parent of the Borrower, (II) the Borrower’s (or any direct or indirect parent thereof) Form 10-K or 10-Q, as applicable filed with the SEC or (III) the applicable financial statements of any Restricted Subsidiary that, together with its Restricted Subsidiaries, constitutes substantially all of the assets of the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries (a “Qualified Reporting Subsidiary”) or (IV) a Qualified Reporting Subsidiary’s Form 10-K or 10-Q, as applicable filed with the SEC; provided that, with respect to clauses (I) through (IV): (i) to the extent such information relates to a direct or indirect parent of the Borrower or a Qualified Reporting Subsidiary that is not a passive holding company, such information is accompanied by consolidating information (which is not required to be audited and may be in footnote form only) that explains in reasonable detail the material differences between the information relating to such direct or indirect parent of the Borrower or a Qualified Reporting Subsidiary, as applicable, on the one hand, and the information relating to the Borrower and its Restricted Subsidiaries on a standalone basis, on the other hand and (ii) to the extent such information is in lieu of information required to be provided under Section 7.1(a)(i), such materials are accompanied by a report and opinion of an Independent Financial Advisor, which report and opinion shall be without any “going concern” qualification or any qualification as to the scope of such audit (other than a “going concern” qualification that is as a result of (i) upcoming or impending maturity of any Indebtedness, (ii) any anticipated, prospective or actual inability to satisfy any financial covenant, (iii) any accounting rule change (including changes in accounting principles or practices reflecting changes in GAAP), or (iv) activities, operations, conditions, financial results, assets or liabilities of any Person other than the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary); it being understood and agreed that the foregoing shall not prohibit any emphasis of the matter paragraph or footnote or any other disclosure or explanatory note. (d) Other Forms of Delivery. Documents required to be delivered pursuant to Section 7.1 (to the extent any such documents are included in materials otherwise filed with the SEC) shall be deemed to have been delivered on the date on which such report or other information is posted on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov, and such posting shall be deemed to satisfy the reporting and delivery requirements of such Section (without action from any Person). 7.2 Certificates; Other Information. Documents required to be delivered pursuant to Section 7.2 (to the extent any such documents are included in materials otherwise filed with the SEC) shall be deemed to have been delivered on the date on which such report or other information is posted on the SEC’s website at www.sec.gov, and such posting shall be deemed to satisfy the reporting and delivery requirements of such Section (without action from any Person). (a) Property. The Borrower shall use commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that all such insurance shall (i) provide for not less than thirty (30) days’ prior notice (or ten (10) days’ prior notice in the case of nonpayment of premiums) to the Administrative Agent or termination, lapse or cancellation of such insurance and (ii) name the Administrative Agent as mortgagee and lender loss payee (in the case of property insurance) or additional insured on behalf of the Secured Parties (in the case of liability insurance), as applicable (in each case, for the avoidance of doubt, subject to the Intercreditor Agreements). (b) Inspection Rights. The Administrative Agent shall give the Borrower the opportunity to participate in any discussions with the Borrower’s accountants. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary herein, the Disclosure Limitations shall apply to this Section 7.6. 7.7 Notices. Promptly (but in any event within any time period that may be specified below) upon any Responsible Officer of the Borrower acquiring knowledge thereof, give notice to the Administrative Agent of the following: (a) of the occurrence of any Default or Event of Default that is continuing (except to the extent notice of such Default or Event of Default has previously been furnished by the Administrative Agent to the Borrower or as otherwise filed by the Borrower with the SEC) (it being understood that any delivery or filing of a notice of Default or Event of Default shall immediately and automatically cure any Event of Default then existing with respect to any failure to deliver such notice); (b) the filing or commencement of any material litigation or proceeding, not previously disclosed to the Administrative Agent or otherwise filed by the Borrower with the SEC, against the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary (i) which is reasonably expected to be determined adversely in respect of such Person and, if so adversely determined, would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect, (ii) in which injunctive or other temporary or specific relief is sought which, if granted, would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect or (iii) which relates to any Loan Document; (c) the following events, within thirty (30) days after a Responsible Officer of the Borrower knows or has reason to know thereof: (i) the occurrence of any Reportable Event with respect to any Single Employer Plan, the incurrence of a failure to satisfy the minimum funding standard (as defined in Sections 412 and 430 of the Code and Sections 302 and 303 of ERISA) (whether or not waived) with respect to a Single Employer Plan, the creation of any Lien on the assets of the Borrower in favor of the PBGC or a Single Employer Plan or any withdrawal by the Borrower or any Commonly Controlled Entity from, or the termination or Insolvency of, any Multiemployer Plan or (ii) the institution of proceedings or the taking of any other action by the PBGC or the Borrower or any Commonly Controlled Entity or any Plan with respect to the withdrawal from, or the termination or Insolvency of, any Multiemployer Plan, in each case, to the extent that such event would reasonably be expected to have a Material Adverse Effect; and

(a) Comply and conduct the Business in compliance with, and make commercially reasonable efforts to ensure compliance by all tenants and subtenants, if any, with, all Environmental Laws, and obtain and comply with and maintain, and make commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that all tenants and subtenants, if any, obtain and comply in all material respects with and maintain, any and all Environmental Permits required pursuant to Environmental Law for the conduct of the Business or their respective operations, in each case, except for any such non-compliance or failure to obtain that would not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect. (b) Except as would not reasonably be expected to result in a Material Adverse Effect, (i) unless being contested in good faith, conduct and complete all investigations, studies, sampling and testing, and all remedial, removal and other actions required in writing of the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary by a Governmental Authority or under Environmental Laws and (ii) promptly comply with all other lawful orders and binding directives of all Governmental Authorities issued or applicable to the Borrower or any Restricted Subsidiary regarding Environmental Laws unless the order or directive is being contested in good faith; provided that compliance within deadlines set by such orders, directives or authorities shall be deemed to be prompt. 7.9 Additional Guarantors and Additional Collateral. Not enter into any transaction with any Affiliate of the Borrower (other than the Borrower or its Restricted Subsidiaries) (an “Affiliate Transaction”) involving aggregate value in excess of the greater of $216,000,000 and 1.50% of Total Assets (which, for the avoidance of doubt, only the aggregate value in excess of such threshold shall be required to satisfy the Fairness Standard or one of the other exceptions set forth in this Section 7.16), unless the terms of such Affiliate Transaction taken as a whole are not materially less favorable to the Borrower or such Restricted Subsidiary, as the case may be, than those that could be obtained in a comparable transaction at the time of

Interest (including post-petition interest), the accrual of interest, the accretion of accreted value, the payment of interest in the form of additional Indebtedness and premiums (if any), fees, expenses, charges and additional or contingent interest on obligations shall not be deemed to be an incurrence of Indebtedness for purposes of this Section 8.2. 8.3 Liens. (ee) [reserved]; (ff) Liens Incurred in connection with a Permitted Reorganization; (gg) Liens securing Indebtedness of Restricted Subsidiaries that are not Loan Parties in an aggregate amount not to exceed the greater of (x) $720,000,000 and (y) 5.0% of Total Assets at the time of Incurrence, and any Permitted Refinancing in respect thereof;
